name: P-850
description: "A record player announced as a refined version of the P-650.Equipped with 2-size, pure electronic full auto function, when playing a record, place the record on the turntable, select the size with the Disc Size button, and press the Play button to auto-lead-in to the beginning of the first song just by pressing the Play button.The P-850 is operated by a photosensor consisting of three photointerrupters fixed to the cabinet and a logic shutter fixed to the tone arm. The built-in microcomputer processes the 3-bit signal from the photointerrupter regardless of the position of the tone arm, and smoothly controls the tone arm to the specified position. The photosensor also detects the rest position and return zone of the arm.All detection operations of this full-auto function are optical, so it is non-contact and does not adversely affect sound quality.Micro computer enables up / down, Oatley turn, Oatley peat, and auto-cut operation.If you want to stop playing in the middle of a song, press the cut button. The motor for the arm lifter is turned on by a signal from the microcomputer and the arm is raised. When it is finished, the horizontal control starts and the tone arm returns to the rest position.Auto Return uses a speed detection type that takes advantage of the wide pitch of the lead-out groove of the record. The speed signal generated by the speed detection coil built into the tone arm drive motor is always sent to the microcomputer. However, when the speed of the arm increases in the return zone, it is detected and the return operation is automatically started.The repeat operation repeats the operation of auto lead in again after the Oatley turn.Equipped with a muting circuit.The P-850 is capable of manual operation in addition to full-auto operation, which is controlled by a microcomputer.The horizontal access is 2-speed access in the same way as the PX-2. Depending on the stroke of the button with center click, you can use either fast access or slow access.In addition, when the arm is moved up and down, a microcomputer controls the system at the time of full automatic operation with a signal from an external button.The tone arm uses an ARS (Anti Resonance Straight) arm developed by Yamaha to reduce any resonance of the arm itself.The ARS arm has a symmetrical structure with a straight pipe so that torsional vibration hardly occurs. In addition, a large rectangular balance weight placed as close as possible to the fulcrum, a span between pivots that is more than twice the normal size, and a rubber damper for the angular contact bearing of the bearing are used to improve sensitivity and eliminate resonance due to backlash. In addition, the pipe holder is large and robust, and a double structure 30 mm from the fulcrum is used to deal with flexural vibration at the front and back of the pipe.The low-pass resonance frequency of the arm was determined to be 12 Hz from the result of measuring the reproduction spectrum of the direct cut record, and the effective mass of the arm was determined by calculating the average mass and compliance of 30 typical MM/MC type cartridge models.The P-850 uses a coreless direct drive motor in the drive system of the tone arm.Structurally, two coreless rotor coils are symmetrically fixed at the bottom of the straight-tone arm and work together with the tone arm, and a two pole-magnetized stator magnet is fixed to the cabinet slightly away from this coil. One of the two coils is for the arm drive. The tone arm is controlled by controlling the magnitude and direction of the current flowing in the coil using the rotational force of the coil based on the Fleming left hand rule when current is applied to the coil.The other coil is used to detect the speed of the tone arm. When the arm rotates, the flux density across the coil changes so that a voltage proportional to the speed is generated in the coil. This speed signal is fed back to the servo circuit to control the rotational speed of the arm.This makes it possible to keep the lead-in error within an extremely narrow range, and the movement of the arm is also smooth. It is a non-contact drive system, and since there are no gears or pulleys in the driving force transmission part, there is no mechanical noise and maintenance free.Equipped with fail-safe function by microcomputer.When the arms sent left and right are stopped by external force, it automatically stops after 0.5 seconds to prevent damage to the mechanism.When two or more buttons are pressed, the microcomputer gives priority to safer operation. The priority is Cut <Left/Right <Up/Down <Play.When the power is ON, 33rpm/30cm is set automatically. When the power is 45rpm/17cm, the size can be set by simply switching the speed to 45 rpm.In exceptional cases such as 33rpm/17cm or 45rpm/30cm, you can respond by pressing the size button after setting the speed.The head shell part uses an insertion type that is highly reliable and easy to replace the cartridge. In addition, the needle pressure adjustment is a sliding weight type.A DC4-phase 8-pole coreless Hall motor is used as the drive motor.This motor has no cogging in principle, and is a non-contact type using a Hall element, so mechanical and electrical noise is minimized.The servo circuit uses a quartz PLL servo that controls with the accuracy of the crystal.In this circuit, the rotation speed of the turntable is detected by an all-around integration type FG (frequency generator), and highly accurate rotation is obtained by comparing the phase with the signal from the crystal oscillator.The cabinet is made of BMC material and uses a 3-mm-thick acrylic resin dust cover and a special rubber W-shaped fold-back insulator to improve the howling margin."

name: P-950
description: "This record player was released as a high-end model of the P series.Equipped with one touch automatic music selection mechanism with built-in optical inter-track sensor.The P-950 uses a special cartridge CG-8000 with built-in optical optical sensor that detects the inter-track portion of the record. You can automatically select a song from the first to the eighth song you want.This function is not available if the dedicated cartridge CG-8000 is not used.Equipped with a full auto function controlled by a microcomputer, the operation such as auto lead-in, up / down, Oatley turn, Oatley peat and auto cut is controlled by a computer.Auto Lead-in is operated by a photo-sensor consisting of three photo-interrupters fixed to the cabinet and a logic shutter fixed to the tone arm. The built-in computer processes the 3-bit signal emitted from the photo-interrupter regardless of the position of the tone arm, and smoothly controls the tone arm to the specified position. This photo-sensor also detects the rest position and return zone of the arm. As the detection operation is optical, there is no adverse effect on sound quality.In addition, the Oatley turn is a speed detection type that takes advantage of the large pitch of the lead-out groove of the record. The speed signal generated by the speed detection coil built into the arm drive motor is always sent to the microcomputer. When the speed of the arm increases in the return zone, it is detected and the return operation is started.Other than that, Up down of tone arm and manual access of right feed and left feed are also possible.The tone arm uses an ARS (Anti Resonance Straight) arm that was developed with the aim of eliminating resonance.By adopting a structure that is symmetrical with respect to the support axis, this arm eliminates the torsional vibration that occurs structurally in S-shaped and J-shaped arms. In addition, in order to ensure stable support of the tone arm, the span between the pivots is widened to suppress unnecessary vibration in this part. In addition, the bearing has a structure that supports the angular contact bearing with a rubber damper, which improves the sensitivity of the arm and eliminates friction.By moving the balance weight closer to the fulcrum and forming it into a large rectangular shape, when vibration occurs in the arm, it becomes large hand force and vibration level is minimized. In addition, by making the pipe holder large and robust and making it into a double structure up to 30 mm from the fulcrum, rigidity is increased to cope with flexural vibration of the front and back of the pipe.The effective length is designed to be 222 mm in consideration of harmonic distortion and rigidity. The low-frequency resonance frequency was set to 12 Hz after measuring the playback spectrum of direct-cutting records and finding that the spectrum of the music signal crosses over at about 12 Hz with the warping and eccentricity components. Furthermore, focusing on the fact that the low-frequency resonance frequency is influenced by the combined cartridge weight and compliance value, the arm is designed after examining the mass and dynamic compliance distribution of 20 MM/IM type cartridges and 10 MC type cartridges.The needle pressure application method employs a sliding weight method in which a counter weight is mounted on the arm shaft and is slid back and forth to adjust the needle pressure. This method is easy to adjust, and since the needle pressure is proportional to the effective mass of the arm, it can be applied to low-compliance type cartridges such as MC type.The head shell is an integrated resin molding type with carbon fiber for high rigidity and high lead-in position accuracy. The terminal is silver plated with surface contact.The Tone Arm's drive system uses a computer-controlled coreless direct drive motor.This direct drive system is a non-contact drive system, and since there are no gears or pulleys in the driving force transmission part, mechanical noise is not generated and durability is excellent.It is equipped with a fail-safe function using a microcomputer to deal with operational errors.When the left and right arms are stopped by external force, it automatically stops after 0.5 seconds.Gives priority to safer action than pressing two or more buttons. The priority order is Cut-Left/Right-Up/Down-Play.A DC4-phase 8-pole coreless Hall motor is used as the drive motor.This motor has no cogging in principle, and is a non-contact type using a Hall element, so mechanical and electrical noise is minimized.The servo circuit uses a quartz PLL servo that controls with the accuracy of the crystal.In this circuit, the rotation speed of the turntable is detected by an all-around integration type FG (frequency generator), and highly accurate rotation is obtained by comparing the phase with the signal from the crystal oscillator.The cabinet is made of BMC material and uses a 3-mm-thick acrylic resin dust cover and a special rubber W-shaped fold-back insulator to improve the howling margin."

name: PX-1
description: "A player system equipped with symmetrical linear arms.The PX-1 arm feed mechanism is designed to move an arm base with six Delrin bearing rollers over two precisely polished guide rails.In order to move this arm base stably and smoothly at a speed that matches the pitch of the record, the angle of the arm is detected by a high-precision non-contact photoelectric arm angle detection mechanism, and the signal is sent to an arm drive mechanism using a coreless motor controlled by a servo circuit that suppresses malfunctions caused by the eccentricity of the record.This arm drive mechanism drives the arm base with low friction using a precision polished drive screw. Since the photoelectric tracking sensor of this arm feed mechanism is non-contact type, no side pressure over the initial motion sensitivity (5 mg) of the arm is applied to the cartridge stylus.In addition, the drive motor is sealed with rubber to cut off rotational and vibration noise, enclosed in a brass case and fixed with an insulator, and torque is transmitted through a rubber belt to prevent vibration from being transmitted to the drive screw.The linear tracking arm is a short arm with an effective length of 190 mm. In addition, the inertia mass is reduced by 40% compared to the offset arm by adopting a rectangular and horizontally long balance weight and moving the shell connector closer to the eye point of the arm. Therefore, the equivalent mass at the cartridge stylus point is as small as 16g. In addition, it is a dynamic balance type because it has a symmetrical design and can balance the front and back of the arm.Since this arm is a linear tracking system, there is no tracking error and no offset angle, there is no inside force. In addition, since it is a symmetrical design, there is a lateral balance. It can be neutral and raced against the recording sound groove. Crosstalk distortion and cross modulation distortion, which adversely affect sound quality, are sufficiently suppressed. Since the balance is left, right, front and back and the equivalent mass is small, excellent tracing ability is shown even for records with sleds.The main shell is a Yamaha special integrated shell (shell + pipe) made of aluminum die-cast for acoustic use. An attachment pipe for universal shell is also included for cartridge replacement.The turntable has a dead weight of 5.6 kg and an inertial mass of 760 kg Ï‰ cm, both of which are made from solid ultra-duralumin.220 pole, 15 winding slot-less DC motor with starting torque of 2 kg Ï‰ cm is adopted for the motor to drive this turntable. Furthermore, the spindle, bearing and housing to support the turntable are designed to be as sturdy as possible. Bi-directional servo with electronic brake, quartz PLL direct drive configuration is adopted.The FG for detecting the number of revolutions is an all-round average push-pull electromagnetic type, and the pitch can be varied by ¥6% by turning OFF the PLL.The player base is made of aluminum die-cast with a thickness of 5 mm, and the insulator is a large combination of spring and oil damper to reduce external vibration.In addition, the power supply part, which causes leakage flux and vibration, has a separate structure to prevent adverse effects from the power supply part.The acrylic cover is 5 mm thick and has a small area and high rigidity structure.To minimize loss of information, we use a Naglex silver clad low-impedance cable and use oxygen-free copper for lead wires to reduce DC resistance.Equipped with pure electronic full auto mechanism of auto lead-in, auto cut, Oatley turn, auto repeat. Also, for manual operation, if you turn the arm feed knob with your finger tip, the arm moves smoothly.Yamaha logic ICs are used for the logic circuit with an LED sequence display that allows operation to be seen at a glance."

name: PX-2
description: "In addition to the know-how obtained with the PX-1, cost and stability have been improved to enhance the player system with a linear tracking system.The advantages of the linear tracking arm are that horizontal tracking error is less and harmonic distortion is less in principle, no inside force is generated in principle, and dynamic lateral balance can be obtained by the symmetrical structure straight arm.In order to improve the accuracy of the mechanism for moving the arm, which is a problem with linear tracking arm, a tracking error sensor is mounted.The tracking error sensor has a structure in which a shutter with a slit is attached to the vertical center axis of the arm, a dual CDs is placed above the shutter, and an LED is placed below the shutter. When the arm deviates from a right angle, an unbalanced voltage is generated in the CDs. Since this photosensor is non-contact type, the sensitivity of the arm does not deteriorate.The unbalanced voltage generated in the CDs is amplified and sent to a DC coreless servo motor for driving the arm base. The rotation is decelerated by a pulley to drive the drive belt attached to the arm base.In addition, a dead zone is provided to cope with the eccentricity of the record, and the effect of the eccentricity is suppressed by utilizing the fact that the feed of the sound groove is always inward. Specifically, the servo circuit starts operating with a deviation of ¥0.5 mm from the offset position of the needle tip and ¥0.15 � from the tracking error angle, and does not operate below this value.The linear tracking servo operates only when the arm is down. When the arm is up, the linear tracking servo is controlled by the left and right feed signals.The servo motor for the arm drive is a coreless motor with high torque and low vibration and mechanical noise. In addition, to reduce the rotational noise and vibration of the motor, it is wrapped in neoprene rubber and suspended from the rear base by butyl rubber with good vibration absorption.A rubber belt transmits rotational torque from the motor to the arm base drive belt, and three plastic controllers with a good S / N ratio support the smooth surface of the rear base to prevent vibration when the arm base moves from side to side on the rear base, thereby suppressing vibration caused by rolling.The PX-2 straight arm adopts a sliding weight method in which a counter weight for applying needle pressure is slid before and after mounting on the arm shaft. This method makes needle pressure adjustment easier and more accurate than the conventional Lee Ka-eun Tarring method.A short arm with an effective length of 190 mm is used for the arm. By using a rectangular and horizontally long balance weight and a shell or pipe made of highly rigid material, the arm has a high rigidity with an optimum equivalent mass. This reduces resonance in the mid-frequency range, and the arm resonance is around 12 Hz, making the arm less susceptible to record warping and eccentricity.The head shell adopts a lightweight and small head shell made by molding pure aluminum blocks exclusively for audio with a high-pressure hydraulic press machine, and has a symmetrical structure without finger hooks.The base of the linear tracking arm is equipped with a height adjustment mechanism of ¥4 mm stroke, and it is compatible with various cartridges.The rotary system uses a coreless Hall motor with a large starting torque and no torque fluctuation, a turntable with a large moment of inertia, and double servo FG + quartz PLL.The rotation speed is detected by a frequency generator (FG) that generates a frequency proportional to the rotation of the turntable. This method uses a coil to detect a pattern magnetized by a magnet that rotates together with the rotor. This pattern and coil are arranged around the entire circumference of the motor. This is an all-round integration type. As a result, the detected waveform is averaged around the entire circumference, and accuracy is improved without being affected by the eccentricity of the detector itself error of magnetization pattern.The signal detected by this FG is compared in phase (quartz-locked PLL) with the reference signal of a high-precision crystal oscillator with a pitch accuracy of 20 ppm. Positive torque is applied to the motor during acceleration, and negative torque is applied to the motor during deceleration. Stability is improved by using both positive and negative servo.When steady rotation is reached, the indicator that quartz lock has been achieved lights up.The Coreless Hall motor adopted in the motor is a newly developed DC4-phase 8-pole coreless motor with no iron core in the stator winding and no gap (slot) between the iron core and the iron core. It has very little cogging (partial torque unevenness of magnetic attraction force), and the starting torque, which is a problem with coreless motors, is as large as 1 kg Ï‰ cm.The turntable is made of acoustic die-cast aluminum 31 cm in diameter and has a moment of inertia of 270 kg Ï‰ cm.2For more information.The PX-2 is equipped with a full automatic control function using a servo circuit that operates the arm. It achieves smooth operability by balancing a full automatic mechanism using a newly developed logic IC and a manual mechanism that has been carefully examined from an ergonomics perspective.The power supply section uses a constant voltage (24 v) power supply with a current margin of approximately 2.5 times that of the constant current of approximately 400 ma.The cabinet is the same as the PX-1. It uses 5 mm thick acoustic aluminum die-cast, and is designed to be vibration-proof and heavy.In addition, a composite type of spring and rubber is adopted for the insulator.The dust cover is made of acrylic resin with a thickness of 5 mm, which is resistant to howling, and weighs 1.3 kg."

name: PX-3
description: "This linear tracking player has further improved stability and operability by utilizing the know-how gained through the development of the PX-1 and PX-2.The tone arm is equipped with a linear tracking servo system.There is a non-contact optical tracking error sensor inside the arm base. When even a small amount of shutter rotation (arm rotation) occurs, an unbalanced voltage is generated in CDs. This voltage is sent to a DC coreless servo motor, which is compared and amplified, and drives the arm base, returning the tracking error to 0.This servo circuit has a dead zone of ¥0.5 mm. If the eccentricity of the record is 0.5 mm or less, only forward movement is performed, and useless arm base movement is suppressed.In addition, the PX-3 uses the same design as the PX-2, such as a servo motor that operates only when the arm is down, a servo motor that can handle the rough pitch of the lead-out groove of the disk with a margin of three times, and an anti-vibration design that suppresses noise and vibration of the arm base drive part.The tone arm uses Yamaha's original ARS (anti-resonance straight) arm.In order to thoroughly suppress resonance in this arm, know-how such as using materials with high rigidity and improving the precision of processing and assembly of parts has been invested.In addition, in order to realize a structure that is less susceptible to vibration, a fully symmetrical design with no offset angle or finger hook is adopted. In addition, the span between the pivots is widened to suppress backlash and reduce the cause of part resonance. The balance weight is made into a large rectangular shape close to the fulcrum to increase the moment of inertia around the rotation axis to suppress vibration. In addition, the rigidity is increased by making the pipe holder part, which is subject to maximum stress, a double structure up to 30 mm in front.For needle pressure application of the tone arm, sliding weight system of PX-2 and P series and copper type is adopted.Compared with the general Lee Ka-eun Tarring method, this method is superior in ease of needle pressure adjustment, fineness and accuracy, and has the advantage that the effective mass increases or decreases with the increase or decrease of the needle pressure.The height of the tone arm part can be adjusted by ¥4 mm.Pure aluminum forged head shell is adopted.The cable uses a low-impedance PU code NEGLEX #2496 with 23 - and 26-core lead wires in a double-cylinder structure, and the pin plugs are gold-plated.A DC4-phase 8-pole coreless motor is used for the rotating system motor.It is a coreless type without cogging in principle, and uses a non-contact Hall element for polarity detection, reducing mechanical and electrical noise.The FG (frequency generator) that detects rotating systems is an all-round integration type in which both the magnet pattern and the detection coil are placed over the entire circumference of the motor. Therefore, it can offset the eccentricity of the magnetization pattern and coil, and pitch error, and can obtain highly accurate detection signals.The signal detected by the FG is compared with the reference voltage and compared in phase with a crystal oscillator with a pitch accuracy of 20 ppm or less (quartz lock), and is fed back to the motor drive to maintain a constant speed.Moment of inertia 210 kg Ï‰ cm for turntable2Aluminum die-cast heavy duty turntable is adopted.The operation system is equipped with a full auto function composed mainly of YAMAHA LOGIC LSI (YM-294) which is the same as that used for PX-2.It is equipped with a one touch, 2-size, electronically controlled full auto system. It integrates two buttons, the Play button and the record size selector. When you press either the 17 cm or 30 cm button, it automatically reads in to the beginning of the first track. This is a system common to the PX series. The read-in position is read out by a 3-bit photosensor consisting of three photo interrupters fixed on the rear base and a logic shack fixed on the tone arm base.In the down operation of the arm, a signal is sent from the LSI to the plunger which drives the oil dump type arm lifter. In addition, the mini plunger restricts the tone arm only during the down operation to prevent the flow from right and left.If you want to stop playing in the middle of a song, press the cut button and the arm will move up by the signal from the LSI.The auto return function takes advantage of the wide pitch of the lead-out groove. When the 3-bit photo sensor senses that the arm moves faster, the auto return function is automatically activated.Repeat operation is a repetition of auto return and auto lead-in.Cabinet is made of high density BMC (Bulk Molding Compound) which is strong against howling.In addition, the dust cover is 4 mm thick and 1.1 kg acrylic.We have adopted a spring / rubber composite insulator that combines a spring with a high anti-vibration effect in the low frequency range and a rubber effective in the high frequency range."

name: YP-511
description: "A record player in which the weight of to vibration are reduced by increasing the weight of important parts.The motor is equipped with an 8-pole 24-slot DC servo motor with a large torque.In addition, improvements such as faster response of the servo circuit have made it possible to maintain accurate rotational speed even against load fluctuations.The turntable uses a 1.6 kg aluminum die-cast turntable that is dynamically balanced from the mold by precision metal processing technology.This turntable has an inertial mass of 220 kg Ï‰ cm to increase the actual weight when rotating by shifting the weight distribution to the outer circumference.2Value.In addition, the material and shape of the turntable rubber sheet with good sound are determined by a strict hearing test.A lead-alloy die-cast arm base of 1.3 kg is used for the arm base. name: YP-D10
description: "A record player that pursues high dimensional sound quality with the UR method (Ultimate Refining Method).The UR method takes note of the fact that sound changes depending on the parts and materials that make up every part. It is an approach to control vibration modes by suppressing micro-vibrations below the level of human hearing. This further enhances sound perfection.To achieve more stable rotation, the drive system of the YP-D10 consists of three stages : a quartz PLL servo for low frequency disturbance, a large inertia of a heavy turntable for high frequency disturbance, and an FG servo for medium frequency disturbance.The motor has a large torque of 1.2 kg Ï‰ cm and uses a DC motor with excellent bare characteristics. In addition, the rotational speed is controlled by the double servo system of the FG (frequency generator) servo system and the quartz PLL (phase locked loop) servo system to obtain high rotational accuracy.In the FG servo system, a rotational speed detector (FG) detects a signal from the FG that generates a frequency proportional to the rotational speed of the turntable and controls the rotational speed of the turntable so that the frequency of the signal becomes constant.The quartz PLL servo system was introduced to further improve the rotational accuracy of the FG servo system. This system controls the frequency of the output signal from the FG and the reference signal oscillated by the crystal oscillator to eliminate the phase shift. The rotational accuracy can be improved to the oscillation frequency accuracy of the crystal. The rotational accuracy when this quartz PLL is applied is within ¥20 ppm including temperature drift.The turntable is made of aluminum die cast with a diameter of 31 cm and has a precise dynamic balance from the molding stage. In addition, it is designed to move the mass to the outer circumference and has an inertial mass of 350 kg Ï‰ cm.2It is improved against load variations at high frequencies where the quartz PLL becomes ineffective.The power supply section uses a strong one that maintains a constant voltage of 24 V even when a current of 1100 mA is taken out to obtain an accurate response to load fluctuations.The tone arm is a gimbal support system with a pivot made of polished chromium molybdenum steel. It has an initial motion sensitivity of 3 mg vertically and 5 mg horizontally. The arm body is an S-shaped pipe arm made of a special aluminum alloy that has more than twice the strength and hardness of pure aluminum. The pipe is filled with a filler to suppress resonance.The inside force canceler is a roller string and counterweight type, and highly adjustable.The head shell is made of high rigidity special aluminum alloy die-cast to reduce the total weight of the tone arm and prevent resonance.In addition, an extremely thin and flexible special lead wire is used for the lead wire to increase the sensitivity of the arm.Since a NEGLEX low-impedance cable is used for the pickup cable, the resistance value from the cartridge to the pin plug is 0.94 ¥, which is less than 2/3 of the conventional value.Also, the plug is gold-plated.Equipped with 6 mm stroke elevation ring rotary arm height adjustment mechanism so that commercially available cartridges can be used. Up and down of 1 mm is possible with one rotation of the ring.The cabinet is not a box but a solid type with 64 mm thick laminated high-density particleboards to reduce the adverse effects of vibration. In addition, a 1.6 mm thick steel plate is used for the back plate to prevent howling. It also protects against unwanted radiation from crystal oscillator circuits and logic circuits.The arm stand and arm base are made of 1 kg zinc die cast and are fixed to the cabinet. In addition, the arm support is fixed by tightening it with a surface like a vise, and unnecessary vibration is suppressed by fixing the root of the arm sufficiently.In addition, a large double damping type insulator has been adopted in consideration of the material.It is equipped with a silent ending mechanism. When a recording is finished and the needle tip of the cartridge enters the final sound groove, the queuing lever automatically operates to quietly raise the cartridge from the recording surface and turn the power off.This mechanism uses a photoelectric detector to detect the moving speed of the shutter attached to the lower part of the tone arm and drives an electromagnetic solenoid to operate the queuing lever and power switch. This mechanism does not impose any load on the arm movement and does not cause any malfunction.Finished with ebony decorative urethane open-pore finish."

name: YP-D71
description: "A highly balanced record player with three overall elements : accuracy of rotation, precision of tracing, and suppression of unwanted vibrations.FG servo is used for the servo circuit.The FG servo controls the rotational speed of a frequency generator (FG) that generates a frequency proportional to the rotation of the turntable. The YP-D71 has a structure that is less affected by eccentricity and pitch error of the detector because the FG that detects the rotational speed is placed around the whole circumference of the motor.Quartz lock PLL servo is adopted to further improve the rotational accuracy enhanced by FG servo.This quartz-locked PLL servo is a control system that eliminates the phase shift between the frequency from the FG and the reference signal generated by the crystal oscillator. As a result, the rotational accuracy of the turntable can be as high as the oscillation frequency accuracy of the crystal, and shows excellent stability against load fluctuations, voltage fluctuations, temperature fluctuations, etc.YP-D71 has a very large lock-in torque of 500g Ï‰ cm. There is no speed deviation against the load equivalent to 40 arms with normal needle pressure. In addition, the FG servo is designed to work in the area where the quartz lock is released, such as at the start. When the constant speed is reached, the lock indicator lights to indicate that the quartz lock is engaged.In the YP-D71, moderate load fluctuations are improved by a quartz servo, and sudden load fluctuations are improved by the inertia mass of the turntable. In the middle part of these, the overall characteristics of the entire rotating system including the double servo and the bare characteristics of the inertia mass motor are taken into consideration and a good balance is designed to obtain the best sound.The newly developed coreless, slotless, and DC Hall motor is used for the motor. name: CT-1000
description: "FM/AM tuner equipped with Yamaha's original NFB, PLL, and MPX circuits.A high-precision wide-gap five series varicon and a low-noise dual-gate MOS FET with excellent frequency characteristics are used in the high-frequency stage and mixer stage for the front-end to improve various disturbance rejection characteristics. It consists of an audio amplifier and a DC amplifier with NFB applied to improve the characteristics. This reduces distortion and noise from the very low band to the high band.The tuning meter uses an optical balance type tuning meter with a red LED dial indicator and a green LED on the left and right sides. name: CT-7000
description: "An FM stereo tuner designed with the assumption that all items will be marked with the best characteristics in the world.In the development of the CT 7000, in order to thoroughly pursue the performance exceeding the limits of conventional measuring instruments, various measuring instruments with special specifications were newly developed first, and the limits that conventional measuring instruments cannot measure are pursued.We are the first in the world to use an ultra-precision frequency number line 7-row varicon in the front-end section. By adopting a double-tuned antenna input circuit, we have obtained over 120 dB in image disturbance, 1/2IF disturbance, and local 2nd harmonic disturbance characteristics that cannot be measured by SG. This greatly improves multi-signal disturbance characteristics such as intermodulation characteristics and blocking characteristics at strong input.Three low-noise -noise MOS-type FETs with excellent high-frequency characteristics are used for the two RF stages and the mixer stage to drastically reduce cross-modulation and realize a practical sensitivity of 2.0 Ï‰ V. In addition, the phase characteristics of the RF tuning circuit and the mixer stage are improved to suppress strong input characteristics and changes in sensitivity, distortion factor and separation depending on the tuning frequency.In the IF stage, a block ceramic filter with a differential gain deviation within ¥0.2 dB is used Shinkai to achieve both low distortion rate characteristics and high selectivity.In order to compensate for variations in the characteristics of conventional ceramic filters, this block ceramic filter is adjusted by combining L, C, and R with the input / output circuit of each filter element, matching the input / output impedance of each element, and realizing excellent filter characteristics close to the ideal.Coupled with the excellent limiter characteristics of a high-gain 7-stage differential amplifier using an IC consisting of a constant current bias circuit, the IF stage of the CT 7000 achieves an effective selectivity of more than 85 dB, a capture ratio of less than 1.0 dB, an AM suppression ratio of more than 60 dB, and an SN ratio of more than 78 dB.It uses a double IF circuit that can switch the IF band between Normal and Wide.By switching the IF band to a wider band, it is possible to receive signals at a lower distortion rate for stations with strong electric field strength.By developing and adopting a linear phase discriminator that minimizes differential gain deviation, we are able to support ultra-low distortion in block ceramic filters and broadband IF stages.The characteristics are adjusted to minimize the distortion factor of each unit by a direct-viewing device, and the characteristics are maintained stable by adopting a direct-coupled two stage constant current drive circuit.Yamaha's proprietary NFB switching method is used in the MPX circuit.This circuit consists of a switching-type mean-value demodulation circuit with NFB as in the case of an audio amplifier. As a result, the distortion in the MPX circuit has an excellent value that cannot be measured by a stereo signal generator. In addition, this method does not require the conventional SCA filter, does not degrade characteristics by the SCA filter, greatly improves intermodulation distortion, and ensures sufficient high-frequency separation to provide excellent sound quality.The subcarrier generation circuit uses a PLL to synchronize the phase with the input pilot signal. In addition, the 38 khz signal sent to the switching circuit is a square wave with duty ratio I, so extremely stable operation, high separation, low distortion rate, and high SN ratio demodulation can be obtained.The PLL circuit is free from the influence of aging and temperature change like the tuning circuit by LC.Yamaha's original active low-pass filter has excellent attenuation characteristics of more than 60 dB at 19 kHz and more than 80 dB at 38 kHz.This filter also functions as a de-emphasis circuit, and has a value of ¥0.3 dB at 50 Hz to 10 kHz and + 0.5 -1.0 dB at 20 Hz to 15 kHz, providing clear playback sound up to the high range.The low-pass filter and variable output terminal amplifier use a 3-stage direct circuit, and the buffer amplifier uses an emitter-follower circuit with a constant current load, so that the distortion of the audio amplifier system can be ignored.Yamaha's original tuning circuit is used.In this system, in order to maintain the tuning point with minimum distortion and maximum separation, AFC is applied to the FM front-end to limit the frequency drift of the FM front-end to 15 kHz at 25 ¥30 ?.This AFC circuit uses the electrostatic noise of the human body, and the Aita that is selected by touching the tuning knob is automatically canceled. Therefore, it can receive the weak radio wave adjacent to the strong electric field station without fear of the pull-in phenomenon.In addition, the AFC/Station indicator lights faintly when the system is tuned to the station during tuning. When the system is tuned correctly and the knob is released, it lights brightly to indicate that the AFC is in operation.The muting circuit is applied double to the input and output stages of the MPX circuit to eliminate all unpleasant inter-station noise and shock noise during ?? and channel selection.The muting level is variable, and a level adjustment knob is provided on the front panel to obtain the optimum muting effect according to the electric field strength of the receiving place. It can also be applied by changing the muting according to the purpose such as cutting the noise at the time of channel selection or receiving only strong radio wave.The shock noise generated when the power switch is turned ON and OFF is also cut off by installing a muting circuit using FET.In the conventional signal meter, the meter drive circuit is saturated at an input of 30 dB or more, and accurate meter indication is difficult. In the CT 7000, the meter is linearly swung up to 100 dB according to the antenna input level by applying AGC to the meter circuit.In addition, a new S-M (signal-multipath) meter can monitor the quality of the received signal.Equipped with auto-blend circuit.The SN ratio can be improved without loss of frequency characteristics even when the antenna input level is ratio can be improved even when the antenna input level is the antenna input level is small.Equipped with multi-path detection terminal.By connecting an oscilloscope to this terminal and adjusting the direction of the FM antenna while observing the waveform, we can accurately find the direction that is least affected by multipath phenomena.It is equipped with two antenna terminals, 300 � balanced and 75 � unbalanced.There is also a connector for coaxial cable that is not affected by external noise.A low-impedance IF output terminal is provided to support discrete FM4-channel broadcasting.There are two types of output terminals, fixed and variable.It has a headphone amplifier.The 3-stage direct connection SEPP-OTL system is used for the circuit so that excellent sound quality can be enjoyed even with headphones.Equipped with an illumination switch, dial lighting can be turned ON / OFF.The sealing panel uses a machined thick aluminum plate.In addition, the cabinet uses a real wood finish with casters (stopper).The CT 7000 measures not only static distortion characteristics (harmonic distortion and intermodulation distortion), which are generally measured, but also Nikaido distortion, which measures dynamic distortion by adding a signal close to the actually used music signal."

Phono2 is fixed at 47k � and 220 pf, and Phono1 is selectable at 100 � and 1k � at MC position and at 100, 200 and 300 pf at 47k � at MM position.In addition, the gain of the equalizer amplifier can be switched on the rear panel, making it easy to adjust with other inputs.NF-type tone control circuit using high-quality film capacitor. High-precision 21-point click special volume and center defeat mechanism.Equipped with 4-connected volume to improve S/N at low volume.It uses a 2-transformer independent power supply that independently feeds the equalizer amplifier section and the flat amplifier section, and eight low-magnification chemi-cons of 4700 Ï‰ F are specified.Equipped with a muting circuit that employs a semiconductor switch to prevent shock noise during power on / off.The output amplifier is equipped with a 0 dB buffer amplifier that enables low-impedance signal transmission.Uses a composite printed circuit board with excellent high-frequency characteristics.It is a unit amplifier in which each amplifier section is housed individually to prevent the influence of disturbance.The front and upper panels are made of extruded aluminum, and the volume, balance, tone control and switches are made of machined solid aluminum.Equipped with a subsonic filter switch, stereo / mono mode selection switch, and audio muting switch.Input Selector Equipped with an independent Rec Out selector.Uses a gold-plated input / output terminal made by scraping out non-magnetic pure brass.An OFC power cord with polarity indication is used."

name: C-4
description: "A control amplifier that has acquired excellent overall mounting characteristics thanks to a current noise reduction circuit.The basic circuit configuration is simple : an equalizer stage of a differential input current mirror cascode bootstrap with a low-noise dual FET developed by Yamaha ; a flat amplifier with almost the same configuration ; a tone control circuit with a continuously variable turnover frequency ; and an MC head amplifier.In addition, Yamaha's original current noise reduction circuit is incorporated to improve the SN ratio when the cartridge is mounted.The equalizer circuit consists of a differential-input current-mirror cascode bootstrap circuit at the first stage, a Darlington connection at the pre-drive stage, a DC-amplifier using pure complimentary service SEPP-OCL at the output stage, and a newly developed current-noise reduction circuit (PAT. PEND) to improve the SN ratio at the time of cartridge mounting.Yamaha's low-noise dual FET is used for the first stage differential amplifier. This dual FET combines the electrical and thermal characteristics of two high-gm FETs with low-noise specifications in the same package. It has sufficient characteristics as the first stage element of a DC amplifier. The current mirror circuit has sufficient gain, and the two transistors act as a kind of push-pull circuit to cancel even order harmonic distortion. In addition, the cascode bootstrap circuit suppresses the degradation of the distortion factor due to the fluctuation of signal source impedance depending on the frequency when the MM cartridge is connected.The second pre-drive stage is an emitter-grounded amplifier circuit with a constant current load using a Darlington connection. It reduces the load on the first stage and provides sufficient gain.The complimentary service stage is a pure output-SEPP circuit using high-fT transistors with well-matched pair characteristics. A large output-voltage is obtained at a low distortion rate while reducing the output-impedance to less than 180 � to improve load stability.In addition, excellent RIAA deviation is obtained by using resistors and capacitors with less error.A newly developed current noise reduction circuit is incorporated in the equalizer circuit to improve the SN ratio when the cartridge is mounted.This circuit focuses on the thermal noise of the load resistance of the cartridge. In order to obtain the desired load resistance, a 10 times higher resistance is used. The current noise reduction circuit produces an apparent desired load resistance. As a result, 1/10 of the used resistance becomes the load resistance, the input conversion noise current density is low, and the load resistance with less noise is obtained.The input terminal of Phono1/2 is equipped with a cartridge load switching function which can select load resistance and load capacity in 5 stages for MM type cartridge respectively.The load resistance can be selected from 100 ¥, 33k ¥, 47k ¥, 68k � and 100k ¥, and the load capacitance can be selected from 100 pf, 150 pf, 220 pf, 330 pf and 470 pf. The load resistance of 100 � is a position exclusively for the high-output MC type.The MC head amplifier section uses symmetrical push-pull circuit with 8 dedicated transistors for the MC head amplifier.Excellent performance is achieved by a luxurious circuit using eight low-noise transistors per channel.The flat amplifier section consists of FET differential-input current mirror cascode bootstrap for the first stage, common-emitter amplifier for the second stage, and pure complimentary service SEPP-OCL for the output-stage. The configuration is almost the same as that of the equalizers.The current mirror circuit on the first stage provides sufficient gain as a flat amplifier, and the two transistors function as a push-pull circuit to cancel out even order harmonic distortion. The complimentary service stage also uses a pure output SEPP-OCL with the same configuration as the equalizer circuit to provide low impedance for load stability.By turning ON the Tone-Bypass switch, a very simple circuit configuration called a DC Equalizer-DC Flat Amplifier can be obtained.The buffer amplifier that receives signals from the input terminals of Aux, Tuner, and Tape1/2 is a two stage amplifier circuit that uses an FET at the input stage and has little distortion. In addition, since the voltage between the drain and source of the FET is held at a constant voltage, the deterioration of the distortion factor due to changes in the signal source impedance is suppressed like an equalizer.The tone control circuit is composed of a differential-input current mirror with low-noise transistor, common-emitter amplifier, and pure complimentary service SEPP-OCL.In order to continuously vary the turnover frequency, a pseudo-variable inductor and a pseudo-variable capacitor are constructed by a circuit consisting of one FET and one transistor. Four pseudo-variable inductors and one pseudo-variable capacitor are used, one for each Bass and Treble. Since the inductor and capacitor are electrically produced, it is strong against electromagnetic induction, and high SN ratio and low distortion factor are obtained.Equipped with subsonic filter and high filter.High-precision, specially designed low-impedance 4-string volume is used. In order to improve the S / N ratio during actual use, 2 strings per channel are used.This double volume is inserted into the inputs and outputs of of the flat amplifier (when Tone-Bypass on). The -�?- is adjusted up to 26 dB at the output side of the amplifier, from -26dB to -4dB at the input side of the amplifier, and from -4dB to 0 dB at the output side of the amplifier. This greatly improves the S / N ratio in actual use and reduces residual noise to 0 when the volume is fully reduced.In addition, since this volume is a low impedance type, the separation and distortion factor hardly change at any position from Min to Max, and good results are obtained.The only coupling capacitor used for EQ outputs is a high-quality electrolytic capacitor and a Meiler capacitor in parallel, and a gold-plated Phono connector.It is equipped with a headphone amplifier. The circuit configuration is a first stage transistor differential current mirror and a grounded emitter amplifier Darlington connection SEPP-OCL.It also has a dedicated volume for level adjustment.Equipped with -20dB audio muting circuit.Equipped with a leave-out selector.Relay circuits are mounted on Rec out and Pre out1/2 to prevent shock noise when power is turned ON / OFF.Equipped with AC outlet."

name: C-6
description: "A control amplifier which is the successor of C-4 equipped with a pure current servo amplifier and parametric tone control.The C-6 consists of a DC equalizer amplifier using the pure current servo amplifier method, a flat amplifier using the pure current servo amplifier method, an MC head amplifier using the pure current servo amplifier method head amplifier that can be used as needed, and a newly developed Yamaha parametric tone control circuit.A pure current servo amplifier is used to prevent the feeding system from adversely affecting sound quality due to the non-linear elements used in the amplifier.In this pure current servo amplifier, a constant current is always supplied to the power supply line so that it is not affected not only by the L/C/R components of the power supply and wiring, but also by the power supply system such as non-linear due to current changes. Furthermore, since no signal current flows to the ground line, it is not affected by ground impedance, and crosstalk in the low-frequency range is improved. In addition, since the current is put in and out from the load inside the amplifier, the loop of output current is small, so the effect of flux generated from this loop is extremely small, and the distortion factor is improved.The equalizer has a cascode bootstrap current mirror differential input with a low-noise high-gain Dual FET at the first stage, a Darlington connection at the pre-drive stage, and a DC-amplifier configuration with a pure complimentary service SEPP circuit at the output-stage. In addition, a pure current servo circuit is mounted.The low-noise high-gain Dual FET used here is specifically designed for low-noise and is packaged in the same package with the same electrical and thermal characteristics as the two high-gm FETs.A pure current servo system is used for the flat amplifier section, and a cascode bootstrap circuit using a low-noise high-gain Dual FET at the first stage, a current mirror differential drive, and a pure complimentary service SEPP are used for the DC amplifier.In particular, by assembling the cascode bootstrap circuit, the drift of the midpoint voltage is very small.The MC head amplifier uses a 2-stage amplifier circuit using a low-noise high-gain Dual FET.As an original tone control function of Yamaha, parametric tone control by servo operation method is adopted.In this circuit, three tone control parameters, such as center frequency (fo), frequency bandwidth (Q), and boost / cut amount (Level), can be varied independently and continuously without affecting each other. In addition, the center frequency is a high-precision 6-row sliding volume for 1/3-octave display, improving operability.A new tone mode selector has been incorporated for effective use of the parametric tone control circuit.In the Defeat position, the parametric tone control is disconnected from the signal path, resulting in a simple circuit configuration with a DC equalizer and a DC flat amplifier.In the pre-out position, the parametric control is the next stage of the flat amplifier and can be controlled.In the Rec out1/2 position, the parametric tone control is built into the recording output jacks and controls the recording signal of the tape deck. In this case, the playback signal from the tape deck does not enter the parametric tone control, only passes through the DC flat amplifier.The use of a remote rotary switch and remote push switch enables layout construction with priority given to sound quality and characteristics.In addition, quality parts such as a plastic electrolytic capacitor for audio and a fast recovery diode are used to enhance sound quality.It is equipped with a special amplifier for headphones. The circuit configuration is an OCL power amplifier with high-voltage low-noise ICs and complimentary service booster.Equipped with -20dB audio muting circuit.It is equipped with a Rec out Selector that allows you to select the source for recording and the source for sound through the speaker independently.Equipped with high filter and low filter.A relay circuit is provided for Rec out and Pre out to prevent shock noise caused by ON / OFF of power supply.You can switch between stereo and monaural with the mode selector.Equipped with AC outlet."

name: CX-2000
description: "A stereo control amplifier developed as a reference for the multimedia era.The digital part is equipped with a wide-capture range jitterless PLL circuit to cope with the fluctuation (jitter) in the time axis direction that occurs in the received waveform due to the difference in the ON / OFF speed of the LED for optical / electric conversion. This minimizes the contamination of harmful jitter.A new fully second order integration filter circuit is incorporated into the data demodulation circuit to attenuate the high-frequency gain of the loop filter when the PLL draws in the normal data and to reduce the high-frequency jitter component. Thus, a data lock signal with minimal fluctuation is sent to the D/A converter.In addition, in the data demodulation circuit, by connecting this perfect second order integration filter circuit to the VCO and forming a multiple feedback loop from the VCO to the PD, the pull-in capability of the PLL for the input signal is improved, and by expanding the capture range to infinity, highly stable digital data reception is realized.In addition, in order to prevent malfunction due to external noise entering the data demodulation circuit, DC servo is applied to the input signal using a differential integration circuit to make the DC component 0, thereby realizing reproduction with less distortion.The D/A converter features a high-bit system consisting of an 8fsx 18-bit digital filter and an 18-bit operating twin D/A converter.This high-bit system increases the resolution of digital signals to a total resolution of 32 times, 8 times the time axis and 4 times the amplitude width, enabling smooth analog signal output immediately after D/A conversion.This enables pure DAC direct playback in which the D/A converted signal is sent as it is without the need for an analog low-pass filter in the latter stage, which has a significant effect on sound quality.In the high-bit system of the CX 2000, the built-in I/V conversion operational amplifier in the D/A converter LSI itself is not used. Instead, an original I/V conversion operational amplifier is used to extract the signal from the D/A converter while keeping the current output, and the gain is improved by 10 dB compared to the conventional one. The gain is lowered by 10 dB by FSH (Floating Sample and Hold) in the latter stage, thereby reducing D/A conversion noise.In order to send the analog signal to the power amplifier in high purity, the high-level amplifier is composed of 2 stages of 20 db flat amplifier and 0 db buffer amplifier, and 4 connected volume which can be adjusted by remote control is adopted, and the volume is narrowed in 2 places before and after input / output, so that the S/N ratio in actual use is improved.In the case of source direct, tone control, mode switching and balance are bypassed, and a simple and straight signal path is achieved.It is equipped with a phono EQ with a built-in MC head amplifier for record playback.Equipped with 6-position impedance switching function, various types of cartridges can be used under optimum conditions.In order to prevent degradation of characteristics due to the routing of internal wiring, a semiconductor selector switch is adopted and designed to be switched close to the input / output terminal.In addition, the logic control of the microcomputer enables you to enjoy A/V independent selective playback such as listening to CD while watching video.In order to eliminate the mutual interference through the power supply line, it is equipped with 3 independent power transformers in which the digital video part, analog part and microcomputer part are separated from each transformer.In addition, the transformer for digital video is separated into three windings and the transformer for analog is separated into two windings. A multi-regulator system is adopted in which a constant voltage circuit is provided for each board such as a phono equalizer amplifier board, tone amplifier board, digital board and microcomputer system control board. This improves sound quality by supplying low-noise, low-impedance power.The power supply for the video section can be turned on and off independently, and the digital section stops the IC operation of the data demodulation circuit when the analog source is selected (including when the analog input of the digital source is selected), enabling pure use for each source selection.In order to eliminate signal interference, the board is separated into separate sheets for each section, and a 6-box chassis has been adopted in which each section is separated and stored in separate boxes.The 6 box consists of a digital part, a microcomputer part, a phono equalizer part, a power supply part, a tone amplifier part and a flat amplifier part. The interior of the cabinet is divided vertically and horizontally by a non-magnetic copper-plated frame. Moreover, the digital & microcomputer part and the line amplifier part are divided into two parts, one above the other, and the whole cabinet is assembled on top of that. This structure greatly improves durability and prevents the occurrence of modulation due to mechanical vibration.In addition, in consideration of the pulse noise peculiar to digital, a non-magnetic, copper-plated top cover is separately prepared for the digital section to cover the entire digital section and prevent propagation of digital noise.Equipped with optical / coaxial digital accessory input / output jacks, 12-position digital & AV Rec Out Selector, 3-band tone control with source direct, balance control, stereo / mono mode switching, subsonic filter, headphone jacks, gold-plated jack jacks, extra-thick OFC power cord with polarity display, etc.Uses a remote control unit that can switch inputs and adjust volume.This remote control is compatible with RS system, and products with RS mark can also be operated by remote control."

description: "Yamaha's top-of-the-line stereo power amplifier with the enormous power and toughness of a studio amplifier without sacrificing the precision and high quality of an audio amplifier.The 101M consists of two monaural amplifiers in one unit, and is a fully twin monaural configuration with the left and right sides separated from the AC power cord. The signal flow is also designed to flow from the front panel toward the rear panel where the power transistors in the final stage are arranged.The power stage is based on a new concept including the power supply circuit so that it can supply as much power as possible with low distortion. Yamaha ZDR (0 distortion circuit) is installed to realize high output and low distortion factor.The power transistor consists of a Pc200W metal can case with a total of 10 para (20 pieces) of each channel and a flexible configuration in which 4 para of ¥120 v are added as required based on 5 para of ¥70 v operation. Therefore, while the power stage as a whole has a high voltage operation capability of ¥120 v, as individual power Tr, 5 para of ¥70 v side does not become saturated, and 4 para of ¥120 v side does not need to be always operated. Thus, a high margin is realized in the power stage as a whole.It is equipped with ZDR (0 distortion rule) which reduces the generation of any distortion to 0 in the power stage, and realizes low distortion by canceling the general crossover distortion in the power stage, thermal distortion peculiar to music signal amplification and distortion caused by speaker back electromotive force, etc..In order to improve reliability at the time of large current and large voltage amplitude, the main power supply for the power stage is separated from the sub power supply for other power stages.In addition, the main power supply is provided with ¥70 v and ¥120 v according to the configuration of the power stage, and the real-time power supply control circuit adds voltage as necessary, thus achieving excellent power supply capability.The power transformer uses an oriented core with excellent magnetic properties, and the winding uses a large transformer of approximately 10 kg, using a thick oxygen-free copper wire with a wire diameter of 2 mm. The primary side DC resistance is as small as 0.35 ¥, making it possible to supply large power.The Chemi-Con of the power supply unit uses 2 para (4 units) of 100V18,000 Ï‰ F and 1 para (2 units) of 63V39,000 Ï‰ F. The total Chemi-Con capacity of the power stage used in one 101M unit has reached 300000 Ï‰ F.It is equipped with a protective circuit to prevent the speaker from an accident.The DC detection protection detects the DC output and turns OFF the speaker relay when there is a DC input outside the DC servo area. The high frequency detection protection turns OFF the speaker relay when there is a high frequency and large amplitude exceeding 100 kHz full power width.In addition, it is equipped with a muting circuit that turns off the speaker relay for 5 seconds with power ON, and at the same time activates the 70 Apeak inrush prevention circuit.When these three protection circuits are activated, the protection LED lights up and warns.A Pc limiter is mounted. name: B-2
description: "A stereo power amplifier using Yamaha FET.The power FET uses 2SK76 (Nch) and 2SJ26 (Pch) developed for B-2.This FET is one size smaller and complimentary service than the B-1 power FET2SK77. In addition to the features of FET such as high input impedance and high switching speed, the pair characteristics required for pure complimentary service FET were pursued, and the original manufacturing method and pair selection method were devised and developed. The device chip size of Pch and Nch, impurity concentration and gate mesh structure are carefully examined, and pair characteristics in a wide operating range are matched by strict control in the manufacturing process. Then, pairing is done by Yamaha's original pair selection method.The circuit configuration is as follows : FET differential amplifier with first stage cascode bootstrap, pre-drive stage current mirror differential push-pull amplifier, drive stage pure complimentary service symmetric push-pull drive, and super pair FET pure complimentary service parallel push-pull OCL.Since the linearity of the FET used in the B-2 is better than that of the conventional one and it can be driven with low electric power, it realizes a simple configuration of two stage amplification in which a stable NFB is applied before the driver stage.In addition, by combining the current mirror load and using a push-pull configuration for all stages except for the first stage, distortion can be suppressed both in terms of material and circuit, resulting in improved bare characteristics. As a result, excellent characteristics can be obtained even with modest NFB.In addition, the DC amplifier configuration eliminates the capacitor from the NFB loop.The output stage is a pure complimentary service parallel push-pull OCL circuit using two pairs of Yamaha original super-pair FETs.This power FET has a drain loss of 100W, good linearity in all complimentary service ranges, and good uniformity in output characteristics. Low distortion factor is obtained from small output to full power. In addition, since Yamaha FET has good linearity from small current range, B-2 operates at low idle current.A large heat sink is used for each of Lch and Rch. A power FET is attached directly to such a heat sink to lower thermal resistance and effectively dissipate heat, ensuring a sufficient margin even at full power.The drive stage adopts pure complimentary service symmetrical push-pull system.In this system, the Nch and Pch FETs of the power stage are each driven by a pure complimentary service push-pull circuit. Compared with the emitter-follower drive system, the drive impedance at ON and OFF times can be equally low.In order to lower the drive impedance of the emitter follower, it is necessary to reduce the emitter resistance of the drive transistor and to pass a large current. In the symmetric push-pull circuit, the drive impedance is sufficiently low even if the current in the drive stage is small. Therefore, the drive transistor has only a small collector loss. In B-2, a high hfe and ft of Pc Ï‰ 1W class is used.The first stage consists of thermally coupled low-noise FETs with precisely matched pair characteristics to form a differential amplifier.In general, the temperature drift of the mid-point voltage is a problem in DC amplifiers. However, in B-2, a constant current bias with temperature correction is applied to the source side using an FET with a high gm, and the common-mode signal rejection ratio (CMRR), which represents the advantage of the differential effect, is very large. Therefore, the drift of the mid-point voltage is stable within 10 mV. In addition, the influence of the minute ripple of the power supply is cancelled, and a high SN ratio is secured.In the conventional amplifier, the distortion factor sometimes deteriorates due to the change of the signal source impedance. This is due to the small drain-to-gate leakage current of the FET at the input stage and the non-linear change of the feedback capacitance (reverse junction of the diode) due to the drain-to-gate voltage. When the signal source impedance is large, the distortion is generated at the input side.In order to solve this problem, the B-2 is equipped with a cascode bootstrap circuit in the first stage differential amplifier so that the distortion does not worsen even if the input impedance changes so that the drain-to-gate voltage does not change due to the change of the input signal.The pre-drive uses a differential push-pull circuit that combines a current mirror circuit for class-A operation to obtain sufficient gain at a low distortion rate.The power supply circuit is independent on the left and right sides to eliminate adverse effects between the left and right channels.A 18,000 Ï‰ Fx2 large-capacity electrolytic capacitor is used for each channel. Before the drive stage, a constant voltage power supply is used to prevent S/N degradation due to external noise and ripple, and to stabilize the operation of the amplifier circuit. This constant voltage power supply is equipped with a protective circuit to improve reliability.The bias circuit of the power FET is equipped with an automatic stabilization bias circuit.This circuit automatically compensates for changes in the bias voltage caused by fluctuations in the power supply voltage and keeps the bias voltage constant. It also uses a diode matrix to prevent the rush current that flows into the FET when the Power switch is turned on, thereby preventing damage to the FET.PD limiter, DC limiter, and temperature rise prevention transformer are used as protection circuit.The PD limiter is a circuit that operates when a speaker (4 � or less) with a lower impedance than expected at the time of design is connected or when the output terminal is short-circuited. It controls the input by detecting the current and voltage flowing through the power FET.This circuit operates at an output of 50W or more at a load impedance of 2 � to protect the FET.The DC limiter circuit is a speaker protection circuit that detects the DC component of the output voltage and turns off the relay at the output terminal.This protection circuit also functions as muting of shock noise when the power switch is ON/OFF.The temperature rise prevention transformer is equipped with a circuit breaker inside the transformer. name: B-6
description: "This is a stereo power amplifier with a unique pyramidal design.The basic configuration consists of an X power supply based on the Phase Angle Control newly developed by Yamaha, and an X amplifier based on a high SVRR (Supply Voltage Rejection Ratio) amplifier and a real-time processor.The X power supply with the Phase Angle Control circuit mounted on the B-6 has a TRIAC element, which controls the AC power by controlling the AC conduction phase angle (Phase Angle Control), inserted into the primary side of the transformer. Information obtained by comparing the output DC voltage of the secondary side with the reference voltage is fed back to the gate of the TRIAC to keep the output voltage of the secondary side constant.Specifically, the voltage comparison amplifier detects that the DC output voltage tends to decrease according to the power consumed in the secondary side by comparing it with the reference voltage produced by the reference voltage generation circuit. The signal from the voltage comparison amplifier is fed back to the primary side at high speed through a photocoupler that combines a light emitting diode and a phototransistor. It controls the signal applied to the gate of the TRIAC inserted in the primary side and controls the power input to the transformer.By controlling the waveform of the voltage applied to the primary side of the transformer by the signal from the secondary side, this X power supply can shorten the energization time to 1/2 of the conventional one. It can supply a large amount of power in a compact form and in a well-regulated manner. In addition, it does not switch a large amount of power at a high frequency close to the audible band like a switching regulator, so there is almost no noise.The amplifier circuit uses X amplification.The X amplifier uses a real-time wave processor that detects the rising speed and magnitude of the output signal and switches the power voltage in two stages at high speed in response to the request of the detected signal. This enables high power, high quality, and high efficiency.The circuit configuration of the main amplifier consists of floating bridge complimentary service push-pull, cascode pure complimentary service pre-drive, and 3-stage emitter-follower pure complimentary service push-pull drive.The first stage employs a high-precision Dual FET and Dual transistor to achieve low drift and high SVRR. In addition to allowing sufficient idle current to flow, the circuit speed is increased by combining it with the pre-drive stage of a cascode-connected pure complimentary service push-pull.The drive output stage is a 3-stage emitter follower with HighfT and transistors. The output stage uses a HighfT transistor molded with copper and plastic in parallel push-pull. The power transistor used in this output stage has an extremely fast switching speed and almost no switching distortion even at 20 kHz. In addition, both NPN and PNP types have good hfe linearity over a wide current range and the crossover distortion is minimized. In addition, since copper is used, there is almost no current distortion when a large current flows.The real-time wave processor consists of two comparators, a derivative (dv/dt) detection circuit that monitors the rise time of the output signal, a level detection circuit, and a high-speed (High) fT transistor, so that the power supply voltage can be switched in real time as needed.It has a built-in PC limiter circuit that detects the collector loss (Pc) of the power transistor and limits the drive when the speaker is short-circuited or when a load of 4 � or less is connected.In addition, we have mounted a speaker protection circuit that uses a relay to disconnect the speaker from the amplifier in the event that DC is input to the input terminal or DC component leaks to the speaker terminal due to trouble. This speaker protection circuit also serves as a muting circuit to prevent shock noise that occurs when the power switch is turned on.We use quality parts such as electrolytic capacitors for audio equipment, fast recovery diodes, metal film resistors, and gold-plated input / output terminals.The cabinet has a pyramid-shaped design integrally molded with aluminum die cast."

name: B-50
description: "A stereo power amplifier equipped with ZDR (Zero Distortion Rule), inheriting the technology of the high-grade B-70.The basic circuit configuration of the B-50 consists of an FET source follower stage, a cascode complimentary service push-pull differential-amplification input stage, a voltage amplification stage by a cascode complimentary service push-pull pre-drive stage, a 3-stage Darlington connection power amplification stage with a linear transfer circuit with a parallel push-pull stage equipped with newly developed ZDR, and an X-power supply.We have developed and installed a ZDR consisting of a distortion detection circuit and an input addition circuit in order to completely eliminate the distortion generated at the final stage of the power amplifier.The distortion detection circuit has a complete bridge configuration and detects only the distortion component. The distortion sensor with this bridge detects variations in the input / output linearity, including errors in the emitter resistance of the power transistor, operating point variations due to non-linearity of the transistor and junction temperature changes, and noise and disturbance from the power supply, all of which are detected as variations in the input / output linearity. In addition, the distortion of the speaker can be detected without being affected by the amplitude and phase of the voltage and current. In addition, the distortion generated by the back electromotive force from the speaker is also detected. Since the elements that make up this bridge are pure resistors, there is no distortion in this part, and the accuracy is extremely high and stable.In the addition circuit, the voltage of the distortion component is added from the floating power supply to the power stage input part as a floating bridge circuit.Since the series addition method is adopted for the signal source, the drive signal current from the voltage amplifier stage and the distortion correction current are kept independent, and accurate distortion cancellation operation is possible without adversely affecting each other.The X power supply, which is also used for B-6, is used for the power supply part.In this power supply circuit, when the DC output voltage tends to decrease according to the power consumed in the secondary side, the voltage comparison amplifier compares it with the reference voltage generated by the reference voltage generation circuit and detects it. The signal from the voltage comparison amplifier is fed back to the primary side at high speed through a photocoupler that combines a light emitting diode and a phototransistor, and the signal applied to the gate of the TRIAC inserted in the primary side is controlled to control the power input to the transformer.The TRIAC element operates like a switch that turns ON/OFF in synchronization with the power supply frequency. In the conventional power supply circuit, the entire cycle of the power supply frequency is input to the transformer, while in the X power supply, the phase angle of energization is controlled as necessary and input to the transformer. This reduces the energization time to less than half of the conventional one. Moreover, since the output voltage does not fluctuate due to power consumption or input voltage fluctuations unlike in the normal power supply, the large power transmission equivalent to a huge power supply is possible.As a result of the miniaturization, the impedance of the transformer can be kept low and the sense of volume in the low range is improved. Moreover, unlike switching regulators, which switch high power at high frequencies close to the audible band, there is no noise. Moreover, with conventional power supplies, when the load power increases, the output voltage drops significantly and the input voltage fluctuates directly. but with the X power supply, these fluctuations are kept to a minimum level.Yamaha's original linear transfer circuit technology is used for the final stage.In this circuit, the bias of each transistor in the parallel configuration is shifted and synthesized so that the transfer characteristic at the time of small signal is close to the square characteristic. By making the transfer characteristic at the time of small signal linear, the occurrence of crossover distortion is eliminated in principle and the bare characteristic is greatly improved.Equipped with a PC limiter circuit that detects the collector loss (Pc) of the power transistor and limits the drive when the speaker is short-circuited or when a load of 4 � or less is connected.There is also a built-in speaker protection circuit that uses a relay to disconnect the speaker from the amplifier when DC is input to the input terminal or when a DC component leaks to the speaker terminal due to a trouble. This protection circuit also serves as a muting circuit to prevent shock noise when the power switch is turned on.Speaker A/B has an independent level controller.Equipped with AC outlet.The level meter uses an LED peak level meter with fast response speed.This meter is equipped with a meter-off switch."
