name: CA-R11
description: "A pre-main amplifier developed based on CA-R1 and incorporating CA-S1 technology.The basic circuit configuration consists of three circuits : a DC equalizer with a low-noise dual FET at the first stage, a DC flat amplifier, and a DC main amplifier with a High Speed High ft transistor equipped with an Ro control that can continuously change the output impedance of the amplifier from -1 � to + 1 �. In addition, a low-noise MC head amplifier and a 0 dB gain tone circuit are inserted when necessary.In the development of the CA-R11, we newly introduced the HP-IB audio analyzing system, which combines a spectrum analyzer and a computer, and examined the characteristics of each unit amplifier beyond the analysis limit of conventional measuring instruments.The SEP-OCL consists of a low-noise dual-FET differential-input current mirror code bootstrap, a Darlington connection predrive, and a pure complimentary service SEPP-OCL.The first stage Dual FET combines the electrical and thermal characteristics of two high gm FETs in the same package. It has excellent characteristics as the first stage element of a DC configuration amplifier. In addition, the current mirror circuit provides sufficient gain with low distortion, and the cascode bootstrap circuit minimizes distortion factor degradation due to signal source impedance rise in the high frequency range when the cartridge is mounted.The second stage is an emitter-mounted amplifier circuit with a Darlington constant current load, which reduces the load on the first stage. The second stage is also designed with a high ft transistor with a well-matched pair characteristic so that the pure complimentary service SEPP output impedance is low enough to obtain a large output voltage at a low distortion rate.In addition, by using high-precision capacitors and resistors, RIAA deviation is also excellent.The flat amplifier circuit has almost the same configuration as the equalizer amplifier. It consists of a low-noise FET differential amplifier circuit, a current mirror and a cascode bootstrap circuit assembled in the first stage, common-emitter amplifier, and a pure complimentary service SEPP-OCL. As a result, a low output impedance (pre-out) of 220 � is obtained.In addition, this flat amplifier uses a cascode bootstrap circuit in the first stage as well as the equalizer stage, so that distortion factor degradation due to changes in signal source impedance of Tuner, Aux and Tape devices connected to the input of the flat amplifier is suppressed.The first stage of the main amplifier consists of a high-gm dual-FET source follower designed especially for low noise and a balanced feed differential amplifier circuit with cascode-connected dual transistors. The second pre-drive stage also consists of a current mirror push-pull differential amplifier circuit. This stage uses a cascode-bootstrap circuit as well as an equalizer and a flat amplifier, so that the increase in distortion factor due to the change in signal source impedance is minimized. The current mirror circuit used in the pre-drive stage consists of two transistors acting as a kind of push-pull, so that even order harmonic distortion is canceled. With these configurations, the temperature change of the midpoint voltage and DC drift due to time, which are especially problematic in DC amplifiers, are minimized, and a stable, high-slew rate, low-distortion voltage amplifier stage is realized.The power amplifier stage employs a pure complimentary service parallel push-pull OCL circuit with 3-stage Darlington connection consisting of high-speed high-ft (gain band) transistors. This circuit has a 3-stage configuration of high-ft transistors with well-matched pair characteristics, so that sufficient power gain can be obtained over a wide band. Each stage is designed with an emphasis on rapid discharge of accumulated charge and stability under no load.To maximize the performance of the High Speed High ft output transistor, a series of diodes and resistors are connected between E and E of the driver stage transistor to keep the resistance value sufficiently low. This reduces the charge discharge impedance of the base region and realizes the main amplifier section with fast rise and fall.Equipped with Ro (output impedance) control that can continuously vary the output impedance of the amplifier over ¥1 �.The Ro control allows you to change the Q, which is related to the damping characteristics of the speaker, without directly operating the speaker system. For example, for a relatively high Q speaker, you can set the Ro control to the - side to lower the Q and make the characteristics flat. For a relatively low Q speaker, you can set the Ro control to the + side to make the characteristics flat.In addition, by using the Ro control and driving with load impedance that cancels out the DC resistance of the speaker cable, the influence of the cable can be reduced.Equipped with MC head amplifier to support MC type cartridge.The circuit consists of four carefully selected low-noise transistors and realizes a 73 dB SN ratio at 100 Ï‰ V input and a characteristic of less than 0.01% at 20 Hz to 20 kHz. In addition, it solves various problems such as the Seebeck effect and noise of the switch contact in the circuit of 100 Ï‰ V order, which is the output level of the MC cartridge, and it can be switched by the selector on the front panel.The tone control circuit uses Yamaha's NF-type tone control circuit. This circuit has excellent control characteristics, and at the time of defeat, the characteristics become flat. In addition, the turnover frequency can be adjusted more finely by using a two step switching system.The internal construction has an almost symmetrical layout pattern with the copper ground line placed in the center to keep the impedance of the ground line low enough. The � B power supply is laid out so that it can be balanced in both vertical and horizontal directions. Negative feedback is taken out from the output side of the arrangement as much as possible to lower the output impedance. The speaker selector switch is integrated with the speaker terminal on the rear panel by the extension shaft, and the connection with the main seat is shortest.In addition, capacitors and resistors with little distortion are used for the parts used, and parts that are especially important for sound quality are selected by hearing.In addition to the input selector, there is a phono selector for the phono circuit, which can adjust the load impedance of the cartridge and change it to the MC position.In addition, 100 � is installed exclusively for high output type MC cartridge.The Rec out selector is provided so that a source other than the one being played by the amplifier can be output to the Rec out.In the Rec out off position, the deck connected to the Rec out terminal is disconnected from the Rec out terminal, so that when the power to the deck is turned off, the input impedance decreases and the sound quality is not adversely affected.Equipped with a subsonic filter, -20dB audio muting and loudness.Pre-out/Main-in jacks are mounted."

name: CDX-2000
description: "CD player with 8 times over sampling and 18 bit high bit system.The digital filter is equipped with an 8 fsx 18-bit digital filter. The digital filter has 225 + 41 + 21 orders of operation order and achieves 8 times oversampling by high-precision digital operation.By raising the sampling frequency of CD from 44.1 kHz to 352.8 kHz, which is eight times higher than that of CD, this digital filter shifts sampling noise, which adversely affects audio signals, to a higher frequency range. Furthermore, the digital filter itself has characteristics of -100dB or less for out-of-band noise and ¥0.0001 dB or less for in-band ripple. Both digital filters have achieved high performance of 16 bit resolution or less. This reduces the occurrence of pre-echo and post-echo, which affect sound quality.The D/A converter uses an 18-bit left / right independent twin D/A converter.In order to eliminate quantization errors, this D/A converter receives the 18-bit output of a digital filter and performs D/A conversion with a resolution four times higher than that of conventional D/A converters. This realizes more faithful D/A conversion the minute signal level where the number of bits decreases.There are two types of audio outputs : filtered through a low-pass filter and direct without a low-pass filter.The feed of the optical pickup is equipped with a unique high-speed access linear motor for quick music selection playback.In addition, to prevent unwanted vibrations from being transmitted to the optical pickup, the mechanical unit uses a heavyweight BMC as the base material to suppress resonance.The servo circuit is equipped with a 2-way computer servo, which automatically switches between fast and slow response to reduce disturbance in digital signal processing and improve tracing capability.In order to eliminate interference caused by electrical and mechanical vibration between the digital servo, audio and power supply sections, we have adopted a separate sheet configuration in which each circuit is composed of independent boards. In addition, the audio sheet is equipped with a copper-plated VM stabilizer that covers the entire audio circuit section from the lower part of the sheet and suppresses vibration.The audio output circuit consists of two stages, a V/I conversion amplifier and an I/V conversion amplifier V conversion amplifier. This allows the audio signal to transmit current and prevents digital noise.The power supply to the digital servo section and audio section consists of a large 2-transformer power supply with an independent shield case.In addition, the power supply circuits for the D/A converter section and the audio section employ a shunt regulator system with independent A-class operation to supply power with low noise and low impedance.The front, top, and side of the cabinet are made of highly rigid extruded aluminum materials, and the bottom plate is made of a heavy bottom cover to eliminate cabinet noise.In addition, a 4-piece heavy insulator composed of sintered alloy, rubber vibration isolator, felt, and aluminum cover is used for the leg part.It is equipped with two digital outputs which are coaxial with the optical system.0.4 dB step digital volume is mounted.This volume has a dynamic range of 120 dB by 20-bit operation.Equipped with 2 speed monitor search, it is possible to fast forward and fast backward while playing. With this function, it is slow at first, and if you keep pressing it, it becomes fast.Equipped with an index search.One touch direct music selection is possible with 10 keys on the main unit or 24 keys on the remote control.Equipped with 3-mode program function of manual, delete and random.Equipped with 4-mode repeat function between 1 song / all songs / program / A and B.Equipped with a space insert function, you can set a silent space of approximately 3 seconds between songs.Alarm clock regeneration is possible by combining with an external timer.Equipped with 24 songs music calendar.Equipped with FL display, track No, index No and performance elapsed time can be displayed independently.It also has an optical head position function that displays the position of the optical head as a percentage, and a volume level display that allows you to check the output level.It comes with a full 44-key remote control that allows you to perform almost all operations from tray open / close, program settings, volume adjustment, etc."

name: CDX-2020
description: "A CD player equipped with a 4 dac high bit system.It uses Yamaha's high-bit system and achieves natural sound quality by obtaining smoother DAC output through high-precision digital arithmetic processing that goes beyond the basic CD format.In addition, the adoption of a high-bit system enables pure DAC direct playback without passing through a low-pass filter, which had been considered essential in the past.The digital filter uses an 8fsx20-bit digital filter to shift the sampling noise to a higher range and obtain high-resolution output.The high-bit digital filter achieves an in-band ripple of ¥0.0001 dB and an out-of-band noise of less than -100dB due to the high-bit digital filter's high-precision digital calculation capability of 225 order + 41 order + 21 order and the characteristics of the digital filter itself. At 16-bit resolution, noiseless and rippleless digital performance is achieved.The D/A conversion section has two 22-bit operation DACs per one channel. By mounting two 22-bit operation DACs per one channel, positive-phase and negative-phase signals are used to prevent noise contamination from the power supply circuit, achieving a high S/N ratio.In addition to improving resolution, the 22-bit operation type also works as a kind of noise reduction circuit, greatly improving the S/N ratio at a very small level.The power supply consists of a large 2-transformer configuration, and the power supply to the digital / servo system and audio system is independent, eliminating mutual interference.In addition, the DAC and audio sections each employ a shunt regulator system with A-class operation, realizing low-noise, low-impedance power supply.Pin-point support GP legs are used for the legs to shut out external vibration.Equipped with newly developed digital emphasis circuit, high performance of 0.001 dB has been realized.0.2 dB step digital volume is adopted.Wireless remote control is included."

name: CDX-10000
description: "A CD player developed by Yamaha to commemorate the 100th anniversary of its founding.We have introduced high-bit digital technology in pursuit of precision that can be called digital resolution.The High-Bit Digital Filter is a digital filter with 225 degree + 41 degree operation and a maximum coefficient word length of 32 bits. It is a four times oversampled digital filter of two stage continuation type that performs double oversampling at the first 225 degree operation and double oversampling at the second 41 degree operation and double oversampling at the second 41 degree operation.As a result, the sampling noise that adversely affects the audio signal is pushed up to 176.4 kHz ¥20 kHz, and the analog low-pass filter in the latter stage has only a gradual cut-off characteristic up to the lower limit of the sampling noise of 156.4 kHz. At the same time, the high-frequency phase shift of the audio signal caused by the analog low-pass filter with steep cut-off characteristic can be eliminated.In terms of digital data interpolation, the sampling frequency of 176.4 kHz allows sample values to be obtained at a time interval of approximately 5.7 Ï‰ s. The D/A output is closer to the original analog signal, reducing the load on the low-pass filter and realizing more faithful analog reproduction.The High-bit D/A conversion system consists of an LR-independent twin-configuration glitch less D/A converter, a high-bit processor DVC with a digital volume controller in the front stage, and a floating high-bit sample-and-hold IC FSH in the rear stage of the D/A converter.The high-bit digital filter can perform 4-times O-field sampling, i.e., interpolation on the time axis, with 225 + 41 operation orders. At the same time, it has a high resolution that can perform an 18-bit output, i.e., interpolation on the amplitude axis, with a coefficient word length of up to 32 bits. The high-bit D/A conversion system receives the 18-bit output of the high-bit digital filter, detects its level by DVC, shifts up all digital signals by 2 bits at most signal levels where the high-order 1 bit is not used, outputs the signals to the D/A converter, and lowers the gain to 1/4 with the FSH at the later stage to realize D/A conversion of 18-bit operation.As a result, the S/N ratio is over 115 dB.It is equipped with digital volume of digital control method, which is essentially free from changes in frequency characteristics when narrowing down and gang errors for each LR channel, which cannot be avoided with conventional analog volume.The digital volume is embedded in a high-bit D/A conversion system to perform 20-bit operations and has a dynamic range of 120 dB to prevent S/N degradation when directly connected to a power amplifier for playback.The volume resolution is 240 points in 0.4 dB steps and can be controlled between -�? and 0 dB with logarithmic change along the auditory sense.We have developed and installed a linear tracking Shinme or unit that employs a linear motor for the optical head feed in order to take advantage of the unique functions of CDs such as track search and index search.Linear motor and linear tracking enable the optical head to be sent from the innermost circumference of the disc to the outermost circumference at right angles to the pit row in the shortest stroke. In the new mechanism unit, when a song is selected, an 8-bit microcomputer stores the head position of each song by replacing it with the position of potentiometers, and the linear motor sends the optical head to the target position by using these potentiometers. Finally, the cue is corrected using the time information of the disc, and high-speed access is realized in which you can quickly call up your favorite song and favorite measure.For the disk drive, we have adopted an FG servo coreless motor, a precision and extremely thick spindle with a diameter of 4.5 mm as specified for broadcasting stations, and high magnetic flux samarium-cobalt is used for the motor magnet. We have achieved high torque and high durability, enhanced stability of disk holding, and increased reliability.Equipped with a tray mechanism that employs a high-torque DC motor for the tray drive and a DC motor for the disk stabilizer.The tray drive motor uses a timing belt drive system instead of a gear drive to prevent unwanted vibration from being transmitted to the tray. A rubber idler is used as the guide roller to ensure quiet and smooth tray opening and closing.A magnetic chucking system has been adopted for the stabilizers that are lifted by a disk stabilizer motor. When the disk rotates, the stabilizers come into close contact with the turntable, eliminating unnecessary vibration to the disk and improving rotational stability.In addition, aluminum extruded material is used abundantly for the tray material, and the disk pad is structured to receive the disk at the outermost circumference of the disk to avoid the risk of damage to the disk signal surface.Based on the concept that good sound comes from good structure, a highly rigid chassis / cabinet is adopted.The front panel is 9 mm thick, the top and bottom plates are 5 mm thick, and the rear panel is 3 mm thick. Inside the external chassis, it is a highly rigid 2-box double chassis with another internal chassis.The internal chassis is divided into two parts, a digital servo mechanical part and an audio part, and constitutes an independent box. The rigid structure design suppresses external vibration and shields electrical noise generated from the digital servo part. This separative integrated CD player is completed.In addition, in order to cope with internal vibration of optical head mechanism and tray mechanism, etc., floating structures are introduced at important points such as floating of optical head chassis by rubber damper, floating of tray chassis by rubber bush, and floating of main body by large insulator made of sintered alloy to suppress internal and external vibration.The power supply unit is separated from not only the power supply circuit but also from the transformer to provide independent power to the digital servo unit and audio unit. In addition, a shunt regulator power supply is used for the audio unit.The shunt regulator power supply can be said to be ideal for the crisis of relatively low power consumption. It stabilizes the power supply by always supplying the control transistor with a current larger than the load fluctuation width required by the circuit and making it operate in class A operation.In order to prevent noise from entering the audio part from the digital servo part in the signal path, an optical transmission method using a photocoupler is adopted so that all electric circuits operate independently.Using seven high-speed photocouplers with a transmission speed of 10 Mbit / s, all signals are separated, the signal paths are connected by light, the digital servo part and audio part are isolated, and the electrical loop is cut off by photo isolation to prevent sound quality degradation.In order to eliminate interference caused by electrical and mechanical vibration between circuits, the digital circuit, audio circuit and power supply circuit from the digital servo section to the audio section are composed of independent boards, and a separate sheet configuration is adopted in which each is separated.The audio circuit board epoxy is used for the audio circuit board to suppress unwanted vibrations in the circuit board and circuit board and to prevent modulation noise.The low-pass filter at the end of the high-bit D/A conversion system employs a fifth order new active type with a gentle cut-off characteristic, and the output buffer employs a full DC amplifier, in order to eliminate high-pass and low-pass group delay distortion and realize flat phase and amplitude characteristics over the entire audio band.The low-pass filter does not require a high-bit digital filter. Since the high-frequency noise is sufficiently reduced, the cut-off frequency is set at a position higher than 20 kHz. In the low-frequency range, elements with a low-frequency time constant such as a DC servo are excluded. As a fully connected DC amplifier, high fidelity waveform transmission from DC to 20 kHz is promised.Even when the severest square wave is input, waveform disturbance such as ringing hardly occurs, and excellent transient response characteristics are obtained.It comes with a wireless remote control so that you can enjoy the CD player by remote control.The 44-key, full-mode specification allows you to open and close the tray, play and pause / stop, as well as track search, index search, 24-track random programs, repeat playback (1 song, all songs, program songs, A Ï‰ B section) and output level control.In addition to with not only analog output terminal but also digital out terminal of 75 � coaxial pin jack specification based on digital audio interface format.Digital output has on / off switch.The audio section and power supply circuit are equipped with Chemi-Con 3300 Ï‰ Fx2 for audio with low magnification foil and high sound quality. In addition, Chemi-Con for audio with low noise characteristics is installed at important points on the circuit board, and high-grade parts such as Mylar capacitors are installed in low-pass filters.In order to reduce the impedance of the circuit, we have embedded pure copper bus bars and other sound quality measures on the audio circuit board.Gold plated brass machined pin jack with excellent corrosion resistance and contact properties is used for analog and digital output terminals.The AC power cord uses a 10 mm diameter cable made of OFC wire and has polarity indication on the power plug."

name: GT-CD1
description: "This is a CD player which introduced the GT (Gigantic & Tremendous) idea adopted by record players such as GT-2000.The GT-CD1 uses a highly rigid and non-resonant structure based on the GT concept.The entire structure consists of a woodbase made of 60 mm thick high-density particleboards incorporating Yamaha's woodworking technology and a mechanical base made from gunmetal castings. The exterior is made of American Walnut with a beautiful sound and polyester mirror finish with a piano finish.In addition, this wood base is lined with a 2.3 mm thick iron plate and connected directly to a 60 mm diameter pinpoint leg with four 22 mm hex iron pillars. The height of this leg can be adjusted by fixing it with screws. In addition, it comes with a leg base that can be detached with magnets.Under the player part, the D/A converter unit is built into a frame structure chassis made of 8 mm thick aluminum block and connected to the wood base. Non-floating rigid structure is adopted for all parts.The player and DAC parts are completely separated in a separate structure. Furthermore, the separated player and DAC parts are placed in one housing in an ""integrated separate structure"".In addition, by placing the master clock in the DAC section and using a VCXO system for the clock in the player section, we have achieved the same level of jitter as an all-in-one player despite the separate structure.The mechanism section uses a top-entry system with a disc player on the base of a 3 kg housing made by cutting out the entire cast gunmetal.The spindle motor uses a high torque brushless motor with a shaft diameter of 4 mm, with an iron plate attached to the bottom to increase quietness. In addition, the disc table is burn-polished with rubber after cutting out brass to ensure high accuracy and prevent slipping during acceleration and deceleration.The clamping system of the disc is a full gravity system and uses a 160g self-weight brass shaving stabilizer clamper. The direct guide ensures high accuracy, and the entire player part is tilted forward 2 degrees to prevent shaft oscillation and stabilize the oil film of the shaft receiver.The top entry lid is made of polished 10 mm thick tempered glass, supported by an aluminum frame and driven by a computer-controlled motor.The optical pickup uses a 3-beam system and is guided by two precision shafts.For the feed mechanism, a timing belt system with a 5-slot motor and a speed reduction mechanism has been adopted instead of a linear motor in order to pursue smoothness during reproduction rather than high speed to improve stability and vibration control.The D/A converter section is equipped with D/A systems such as Yamaha's original secondary noise shaping, I-PDM 1-bit DAC, and TBC with higher precision.The main improvements are as follows : Review of noise shaping to improve the output level by 4 dB by making the most effective use of signal components. Adoption of newly developed LSI capable of 20-bit input. Detection of Infiniti 0 improves the output of the noise shaping circuit and eliminates fluctuation components. Optimization of FET size of output inverter to optimize the waveform of output pulse and reduce unnecessary radiation due to high frequency noise.In addition, the twin DAC system, in which the DAC with the processing capacity for two channels in one chip is used independently on the left and right sides, prevents mutual interference. In addition, the signal of one channel is output in two systems with positive phase for the signal component and negative phase for the dither component. By combining these outputs, the dither component is canceled and random noise is reduced by 3 dB.The DAC section is located on the same main board as the audio amplifier section, but it is shielded by a copper plate to prevent interference with the audio amplifier section. A shield plate is also placed between each DAC to eliminate mutual interference between channels.The use of second order noise shaping and twin DAC system greatly reduces noise outside the audible band. Therefore, the third order active type low-pass filter, which is advantageous in sound quality, is used.The audio amplifier consists entirely of discrete transistors, with differential-input / complimentary service outputs and class-A operation at all stages to achieve pure amplification and transmission. In addition, only audio parts that have been examined through repeated comparative listening are used.In addition, the twin DAC configuration completely separates the positive-phase and negative-phase signals from the DAC and realizes a balanced output capable of high-quality sound transmission by realizing a symmetrical balanced circuit containing four amplifiers with two channels.The power supply section is separated from the servo / DAC system, audio amplifier system, and transformer, and is further divided into two transformers and three windings for the servo system and DAC system to eliminate mutual interference.In addition, only the audio amplifier section is equipped with a powerful power supply section such as a 15Ax2 rectifier and a filter capacitor of 48000 Ï‰ F or more.It uses a design that combines the player part with walnut polyester mirror coating finish and the DAC part with aluminum extruded material anodized finish.3-step switching type is adopted for the display part.Wireless remote control is included."

name: GT-CD2

The exterior of the GT-CD2 is made of American Walnut sound, with an open-pore finish.The wood base is lined with 2.3 mm thick steel plates, and is directly connected to the GP legs, which consist of round steel machined pinpoint legs and removable leg-bases, by using four 22 mm hex iron poles opposite each other. Furthermore, the separated player and DAC parts are placed in one housing in an ""integrated separate structure"".In addition, by placing the master clock in the DAC section and using a VCXO system for the clock in the player section, we have achieved the same level of jitter as an all-in-one player despite the separate structure.The mechanism section uses a top-entry system with a disc player on the base of a 3 kg housing made by cutting out the entire cast gunmetal.A brushless motor with a shaft diameter of 4 mm is adopted for the spindle motor, and rubber is attached to the brass machined disk table to ensure high accuracy and prevent slipping during acceleration and deceleration.The pickup section uses a 3-beam system. Guided by two precision shafts, the timing belt feed mechanism gives priority to stability and quietness, and realizes smooth playback.The clamp of the disk is gravity type, and it uses a round steel shaving clamper of 160g weight. In addition, high accuracy is ensured by using the shaft of the motor as it is in the center.In addition, the entire player part is tilted two degrees toward the front of the housing to prevent the shaft from swinging and to stabilize the oil film of the bearing.The D/A converter uses Yamaha's original I-PDM 1-bit DAC and secondary noise shaping.Accurate D/A conversion is achieved by combining the I-PDM method, which achieves accurate analog conversion even if the digital waveform is not ideal, and the secondary noise shaping method, which ensures a high dynamic range while reducing out-of-band noise to a low level.In addition, by using DACs with a processing capacity of 2 ch in one chip independently on the left and right sides, mutual interference can be prevented, positive and negative phase signals can be output, dither components are completely cancelled, and random noise is reduced by 3 dB.The audio section is composed of discrete elements composed entirely of transistors. It has differential-input, complimentary service output-class A operation.Audio parts used in GT-CD1 are used for parts.In the power supply section, the servo / DAC and audio amplifier sections are separated from the transformer, and the servo and DAC sections are wound separately to reduce interference. In the filter condenser, the audio section is at least 27,000 Ï‰ F and the DAC section is at least 10,000 Ï‰ F.Uses an aluminum cutting switch.Equipped with 3-step display switching function.Wireless remote control is included."

name: EC-1
description: "Electronic crossover network with continuously variable crossover frequency, 3-stage slope selector, and Q control circuit.The EC-1 consists of an input buffer amplifier based on Yamaha's original DC-amplifier module, a low-pass filter for low band, a high-pass filter + low-pass filter for middle band, and a Route 3 filter unit for high-pass filter for high band, connected in parallel with a time-constant device that employs a high-speed, wide-band, highly reliable operational amplifier and high-precision resistors and capacitors.Each filter can vary the crossover frequency by five octaves continuously, and the slope characteristics can be changed between 6dB/oct., 12dB/oct., and 18dB/oct. When the slope characteristics are 12dB/oct., Q, which represents the filter's shoulder characteristics, can be controlled in the range of 0.5 to 1.The Dividing Function Selector on the rear panel allows you to select three filter modes : 3-way, 2-way-1 and 2-way-2.The circuit configuration of the buffer amplifier consists of Yamaha's original low-noise dual-FET differential-amplifier circuit, cascode bootstrap, first stage of current mirror circuit assembly, base-grounded amplifier drive stage, and pure complimentary service push-pull emitter-follower complimentary service stage with high fT and uniform output characteristics.This buffer amplifier uses a low-noise Dual FET at the first stage to reduce noise. The cascode bootstrap circuit and current mirror circuit are assembled to prevent the mirror effect due to the FET feedback capacitance to improve frequency characteristics. In addition, problems such as degradation of distortion due to variation of signal source impedance and drift of mid-point voltage of DC amplifier are solved by the adoption of cascode bootstrap circuit and Dual FET to obtain excellent low-distortion characteristics and stability.The second stage common-base amplifier circuit can minimize the mirror effect compared with common-emitter amplifier circuit, etc., and is stable against a large amount of NF in a wide band.The pure complimentary service push-pull emitter-follower at the final stage is equipped with complimentary service transistors with sufficient Pc margin and high fT pair characteristics, so that three pairs of parallel-connected filter circuits can be driven with sufficient A-class margin.In addition, this buffer amplifier is packaged in a plastic case and hardened with epoxy resin to form a module, and reliability and temperature characteristics are improved.The EC-1 uses 16 sets of filter amplifiers, 2 sets each for each filter. The filter amplifier uses a voltage follower circuit based on the High-Speed wide-band operational amplifier ICLM 310, which realizes sufficient attenuation characteristics by obtaining sufficient output impedance of 1 � or less.The voltage follower ICLM 310 is an IC equivalent to 19 transistors and is a DC amplifier configuration with a cascode bootstrap circuit. It realizes high-speed, wide-band, and high reliability with low noise.The filter circuit has three types of slope characteristics : 6dB/oct., 12dB/oct., and 18dB/oct.The 6dB/oct filter is a passive filter with an output buffer amplifier. The crossover frequency can be changed every one octave by switching C and continuously within ¥0.5 octave by VR.The 12-dB / oct. filter is a second order active filter. The crossover frequency can be changed by one octave by switching two sets of C switches, and can be continuously changed within ¥0.5 octave by two linked VRs. It is also equipped with a Q control circuit that can subtly control shoulder characteristics near the crossover frequency.The 18dB/oct. filter has a CR-1 stage passive filter with an output buffer after a 12dB/oct., Q = 1 secondary active filter to obtain the flattest characteristics. The crossover frequency can be changed by one octave by switching three sets of C, and can be continuously changed within ¥0.5 octave by three linked VRs.The sound quality and characteristics are improved by using carefully selected parts.We have adopted Yamaha's original low-noise Dual FET (2SK100) for the first stage of the buffer amplifier. We have also adopted low-noise signal amplifiers with particularly good linearity. We have also adopted a high-speed, wide-band, high-reliability voltage follower ICLM 310 for the filter amplifier.All of the capacitors used in the signal system as the time constant element of the filter are high-precision ¥1% polypropylene film capacitors. These polypropylene film capacitors not only have high accuracy, but also have low tan � and excellent high-frequency characteristics, and excellent results are obtained even in a hearing check.A metal film resistor with a structure in which a resistor and an electrode are formed on a ceramic substrate by vacuum evaporation method and then covered with an epoxy resin is used. This metal film resistor has excellent characteristics such as a temperature coefficient of ¥50 ppm / Ï‰ and an error of ¥1%.All variable resistors are made of conductive plastic volume, which is highly accurate within ¥2% accuracy and within ¥1 db of gang error.A double-sided through hole glass epoxy substrate is used for the substrate. In addition, low-distortion switches are used with attention paid to the distortion generated by the switches in use. All input / output terminals are gold-plated.The Dividing Function selector allows you to select three filter modes : 3-way, 2-way-1, and 2-way-2, and Pass mode.The 3-way position operates as a Low, Mid, and High 3-way network with two crossover point LEDs lit. The 2-way-1 position operates as a 2-way network with a crossover point between Low and Mid, and the 2-way-2 position operates as a 2-way network with a crossover point between Mid and High.The Pass position operates as a 0 dB gain full-range buffer amplifier, and is output to the Low terminal on the rear panel.The Slopep selector allows you to select slope characteristics of 6dB/oct., 12dB/oct., and 18dB/oct. independently at four points (LPF side and HPF side) at the upper and lower crossover points.The 6dB/oct position has a gentle cutoff characteristic, so that smooth sound connection can be obtained when the characteristics of the speaker unit used are wider and better than the frequency band set by Crossover.At the position of 12dB/oct., Q, which represents the shoulder characteristics of the filter, can be controlled from 0.5 to 1.A position of 18dB/oct is effective when the crossover frequency is close to the divided vibration region of the unit because the cutoff characteristic is steep.The crossover selector allows you to select five points of 50Hz/100Hz/200Hz/400Hz/800Hz per octave between Low and Mid, and five points of 800Hz/1.6kHz/3.2kHz/6.4kHz/12.8 kHz per octave between Mid and High.In addition, the frequency set by the crossover selector can be adjusted continuously by ¥0.5 octave on the LPF side and HPF side independently by the crossover fine adjustment knob. Therefore, the crossover frequency can be adjusted continuously from 35 Hz to 1.13 kHz between Low and Mid and from 565 Hz to 18.1 kHz between Mid and High.With the Q control, when the slope characteristic is 12dB/oct., Q, which represents the shoulder characteristic of the filter, can be continuously adjusted in the range of 0.5 to 1. This allows you to adjust the sum of the outputs of the crossover band to compensate for peaks and dips in the crossover band.Ten memory cards are included to record the settings of the various controls of the EC-1. These memory cards can be stored in the memory card holder at the bottom of the EC-1.High Quality Gold Plated Three Pin-Pin codes are included. This Pin-Pin code is equivalent to the commercial product CP-10 (¥2500) and has double spiral structure with DC resistance of 0.07 � (reciprocating) and capacitance of 120 pf (1 khz, 1.2m)."

name: FX-1
description: "This large-size floor-type speaker system was developed using Yamaha technology as a full-scale home-produced floor-type speaker.A 38 cm cone type woofer, JA 3805, is mounted in the low range.The cone uses a non-pre-cone with corrugation made of carefully selected materials. Both the urethane roll edge and the base fabric and impregnated material are supported by a damper that has been sufficiently selected and audibly selected.The voice coil consists of a heat-resistant NOMEX bobbin with a 100 � large diameter and 18 mm width wound with a pure copper ribbon wire. A zinc reinforcement ring is attached to the neck to prevent the voice coil bobbin from bending. This realizes a voice coil that can withstand a large input power of 100W continuously.The magnetic circuit uses an internal 90 � x40 � x40 / 1.5 kg Alnico magnet and the magnetic flux density of the voice coil gap is 12,500 Gauss. The pot yoke uses ductile cast iron and the weight of the magnetic circuit reaches 6.7 kg.The frame that holds the entire vibration system is made of aluminum alloy and has a weight of 2.65 kg.The mid-range is equipped with a horn type squaker, JA 6602.A beryllium dome diaphragm with a diameter of 66.6 � and a dead weight of 0.7g is used for the diaphragm, and a tangential edge made of aluminum alloy is used for the edge to obtain sufficient linearity for amplitude.The voice coil uses a 66.6 � aluminum ribbon wire. The magnetic circuit uses a 1.34 kg alnico magnet. Both the center pole and outer pole use a pure iron to obtain a magnetic flux density of 18,500 Gauss. In addition, a silver ring is attached to the outer circumference of the center pole to suppress the generation of third strain caused by magnetostriction and the fluctuation of impedance characteristics.The horn is equipped with an exponential horn with a cutoff of 200 Hz, a total length of 273 mm, an aperture ratio of 103 mm, and a dead weight of 2.3 kg. A slant-plate acoustic lens is used to improve the directional characteristics of the high-frequency range.The equalizer is a 3-part zinc-machined type, and the back cover is made of cast aluminum with a thickness of 30 mm. Urethane and felt are used as sound absorbing materials.A horn type tweeter, JA 4202, is mounted in the high range.The diaphragm uses a beryllium ring diaphragm with a thickness of 40 Ï‰ m and a weight of 0.2g. This ring diaphragm is a V-shaped diaphragm with an outer diameter of 50 mm and an inner diameter of 30 mm and provides rigidity.The voice coil is made of pure aluminum and is only 0.2g in spite of its 42 � diameter. The total weight of the vibration system is less than 0.5g. In addition, the magnetic circuit is an with an Alnico magnet and has a magnetic flux density of 18,500 Gauss.In order to improve directional characteristics by adopting a large diameter ring diaphragm, a spherical horn with a special shape is adopted and the aperture diameter is reduced (29 �).The horn itself is a short-cut type exponential horn with low cut-off (1440 Hz) and machined from solid aluminum.A low-distortion inductor (distortion rate of 0.05% or less at 100W) using an E-type core made of large silicon steel sheets is used for the woofer circuit of the network.A large MM capacitor with low dielectric loss and low distortion factor is used for the capacitor, and a non-inductive type is used for the attenuator.The enclosure is a large-volume bass-lef-floor type, with 25 mm thick Douglas-fir plywood for the baffle plate and 25 mm thick high-density particleboards for the other parts, and each part is reinforced.The inside is packed with carefully selected glass wool as a sound absorbing material, and the weight of the cabinet reaches 46 kg.The exterior is finished with a crystal black polyester matte finish with rosewood accent."

name: FX-3
description: "A large-floor-type speaker system that adopts beryllium diaphragm for middle and high range units.It is equipped with JA 3601 which is a 36 cm cone type woofer in the low range.The cone uses a conical type with corrugation made from pulp that has been carefully examined in terms of sound quality. It reduces split vibration and provides a wide range of piston motion. In addition, urethane foam roll edge is used for the edge. The linearity of the damper is improved by giving sufficient consideration to the base fabric and impregnation agent.The voice coil is a long voice coil type in which copper ribbon wire is wound edgewise on a heat-resistant NOMEX bobbin. It ensures good linearity even under Dainyu force. A zinc-reinforced ring is attached to the neck of the voice coil to prevent irregular motion caused by the deflection of the voice coil and to suppress harmonic distortion.The magnetic circuit uses a large ferrite magnet of 200 � x120 � x20tmm to obtain a total magnetic flux of 260,000 maxwell and a magnetic flux density of 12,000 gauss. The center pole is covered with a copper cap a copper cap to minimize the generation of magnetic distortion, reducing the annoying third harmonic distortion.The frame uses an aluminum die-cast frame exclusively for audio.The middle area is equipped with JA 0802 which is a 8.8 cm hard dome type skoker.The diaphragm uses a beryllium diaphragm with a small radius of curvature (deep dome shape) made by Yamaha's electron beam vacuum evaporation method. Several molds (substrates) are put into a vacuum evaporation furnace to manufacture several sheets at the same time. One of the completed diaphragms is immediately incorporated into a unit for trial listening. If not satisfied, all of the diaphragms deposited at the same time are discarded. In addition, a diffuser is used to suppress the valley caused by interference in the out-of-band on-axis characteristics occurs when the beryllium diaphragm is shaped into a dome shape with a small radius of curvature.The voice coil is made of a durable kraft paper bobbin with strong edgewise winding of copper ribbon wire with high space factor. The edge is made of a special fiber tangential edge with high linearity by double coating of viscoelastic resin and thermosetting resin.In order to ensure linear and high-transient operation, this SCOKER takes into consideration that the air pressure in each part such as the beryllium diaphragm, voice coil and tangential edge is equal. Behind the diaphragm, the center pole is largely hollowed out and communicates with the back cavity. Behind the voice coil, an air hole is made in the bottom plate of the magnetic circuit and communicates with the back cavity. In addition, behind the edge, a hole is made in the voice coil bobbin and a hole is made in the outer pole to ensure linear operation of the vibration system.The magnetic circuit uses ferrite magnet of 156 � x80 � x25tmm, realizing total magnetic flux of 130,000 maxwell and magnetic flux density of 16,000 gauss.A 3.0 cm hard dome type tweeter, JA 0526, is mounted in the high range.The diaphragm is made of beryllium, similar to Scoker, and is a 0.028g lightweight diaphragm. The voice coil is made of a kraft paper bobbin with an edgewise winding of lightweight copper-clad aluminum ribbon wire. It is supported by a special fiber tangential edge with double coating of viscoelastic resin and thermosetting resin.The magnetic circuit uses a 100 � x50 � x22tmm ferrite magnet with a total magnetic flux of 33,000 maxwell and a magnetic flux density of 18,500 gauss.For the network section, a large ferrite core bobbin and 99.98% pure copper wire with low DC resistance are used, and MP capacitors selected by sound quality check are used as capacitors.In addition, in order to reduce the effect of mutual inductance between coils, the coils are mounted at right angles to each other with a sufficient distance.Skokor and tweeter are equipped with continuously variable level control.The attenuator used has a sufficiently large allowable input and a precision attenuator with low sound quality degradation.The enclosure is finished as a large-capacity floor type with an internal volume of 120L.The entire surface is made of the same particleboard. The surface is finished with a shiny oak finish and the baffle plate is finished with a black finish. This particleboard is denser and harder than ordinary ones. It is reinforced using the woodworking know-how gained through the manufacture of musical instruments."

name: NS-100M
description: "This is a speaker system with a clear concept of ""original book shelf"" by rethinking what a bookshelf type is and how it should be.A 20 cm cone type woofer is used for the low range.For corn paper, we use white corn produced by Yamaha's original sheet manufacturing method based on the accumulated know-how of material research.This corn paper is made from a sheet of foreign coniferous wood based raw materials by a special manufacturing method incorporating old Japanese paper technology, and finished into a cone-type straight cone with clear motion characteristics. Because of the sheet manufacturing method, there is less unevenness in density and thickness compared with the produced corn paper. Moreover, because the paper quality is finished in the Middle Ages (PH7), there is less change over time and durability is improved.The voice coil for driving the cone paper is made of a kraft paper bobbin wound with copper flat wire with high space factor and heat-resistant adhesive. The damper diameter is 20% larger than the conventional one so that it can withstand large amplitude, and the material and impregnation agent are newly examined.A strong magnet with a total magnetic flux of 78,000 maxwell is used, and an acoustic aluminum die-cast frame is used.We have developed and adopted a multi-coating agent that blends 7 kinds of viscoelastic chemicals for 6 hours for the soft dome diaphragm in the middle and high frequency range. Since it is adopted for both the tweeter and skoker, the sound connection between units and characters are unified.In addition, the fabric molded into the soft dome is an original woven fabric developed exclusively for it, and the density of the warp and weft is made to be the same, and directivity and dispersion are suppressed.In addition, since each tangential edge is integrally molded, no edge is added later and no coating agent is applied after molding, resulting in an excellent balance and high accuracy.A 5.5 cm soft dome type skoker is used for the middle area.The dome shape is set to the optimum value for obtaining excellent frequency characteristics and directivity, and glass wool is filled as a damping material on the back of the diaphragm. The optimum value is 0.3 ¥0.05g, which is a strict design.The voice coil is made of Yamaha's original FRP sheet made of glass fiber and tightly wound with copper flat wire with high space factor to achieve high input resistance. Ferrite magnet is used for the magnet.In addition, the glass wool filled inside the unit and the air brake by the installation of the back cavity work together, and fo is finished as low as 400 Hz, making the connection with the woofer smooth.A 3.0 cm soft dome type tweeter is used for the high range.The voice coil is made of an edgewise winding of copper clad aluminum ribbon wire, which is lightweight and has good conductivity, and is directly connected to the soft dome diaphragm to reduce the weight of the vibration system.A magnetic circuit with a total flux of 20,000 maxwell is used.In addition, an acoustic diffuser is installed on the front to improve directional and frequency characteristics.In the network, decisions are made by cut-and-try based on the sense of hearing.For the coil, 99.98% purity copper wire with low DC resistance is used for bobbin made of ferrite core, and MP tubular capacitor is used for the capacitor.In addition, in order to reduce the reverberation between the coils, the coils are mounted at right angles, and the input terminal is not relayed from the output terminal to the input terminal so as to prevent the deterioration of damping and the increase of distortion at large input.The Tweeter and Skoker are equipped with continuously variable level control.The enclosure is a six sided one piece structure consisting of a single front-facing particleboard joined by a strong adhesive.In particular, for the connection of the baffle plate (20 mm) and the side plate (15 mm) with different thicknesses, a three way flow stopper is adopted, which requires advanced technology, to improve rigidity. In addition, baffle cut-out material is attached to the back plate, and each part is reinforced to suppress unnecessary resonance. In addition, two types of glass wool with different densities are used depending on the location for the filler material to bring out the sense of volume especially in the low range.The exterior finish is the same as the NS-1000M with 7 steps and layer black monitor finish.In consideration of phase and directional characteristics, the mounting position of the unit is designed to be symmetrical."

This diaphragm has improved directional characteristics by having a shape with a small radius of curvature. The resulting valley caused by interference in the out-of-band on-axis characteristics is suppressed by using a diffuser.In addition, the voice coil uses an edgewise wound oxygen-free copper ribbon wire, and the edge uses a tangential edge made of a special fiber with double coating of viscoelastic and thermo-setting resins linearity.The magnetic circuit uses a ferrite magnet of 156 � -80 � -25tmm, and the magnetic flux density is 18,400 gauss and the total magnetic flux is 150,000 maxwell.A 3 cm hard dome type tweeter, JA 0526 a is mounted in the high range.The diaphragm is made of pure beryllium as well as the mid-range diaphragm. name: NSX-10000
description: "This speaker system was developed to commemorate the 100th anniversary of Yamaha's founding. The concept of this system is to clear the physical possibilities of digital sound in terms of performance, and to sing out the musical possibilities of digital sound in terms of sound quality.We aim to achieve no-distortion, high-transient and no-noise, high-resolution capabilities comparable to digital sources.A cone type unit with a 33 cm pure carbon diaphragm is used for the low range.In order to take advantage of the characteristics of carbon, it is made of long-fiber carbon fiber and unidirectional arrangement, which is well known for NS-2000 and NS-1000X.This is a long-fiber roll sheet that can be said to be the prototype of carbon fiber. It is made by stacking four sheets of a fan-shaped sheet, 32 sheets of a cone divided into eight equal parts, cut in the fiber direction, and shifted by one fourth with resin as a matrix.The shape of the diaphragm is a straight conical type and realizes high rigidity while taking advantage of tensile and compressive strength in the fiber direction.The center cap also uses the same unidirectional arrangement and long-fiber pure carbon fiber.The voice coil is an edgewise wound voice coil that uses OFC (oxygen-free copper) wire for the wire material.The frame has been newly designed using computer simulation technology to suppress resonance. The aluminum die-cast frame for the woofer is 12 mm thick at the frame flange. The frame arm has also been modified from the usual V-shaped arm to a U-shaped arm. The frame arm is moved out of the frequency band where the primary resonance mode occurs within the frequency band used by the woofer.In addition, in order to suppress unnecessary vibration of each part of the woofer including the magnet, the frame and the bottom plate are joined by 4 bolts of 10 mm diameter like sandwiching the magnet, and the rigidity of the whole woofer unit is further increased.For the mid-range and high-range, 8.8 cm and 3.0 cm dome type units with GC beryllium are adopted.GC beryllium improves the structure of beryllium crystals and achieves giant crystallization. Since each crystal grows large, there are fewer boundaries between crystals, reducing the transmission loss of sound waves.The voice coil bobbin is also made of GC-beryllium, which is the same material used for the diaphragm, to improve the heat conduction characteristics, thereby improving the allowable input resistance. The wire is made of OFC (oxygen-free copper) wire for the Skoker, and copper-clad / aluminum wire for the tweeter, making it an edge-wise wound voice coil.It is equipped with a diffuser and made of brass in order to expand the medium and high sound with strong rectilinear motion to the listening area with wide angle.After carefully polishing each piece with fine buffing material, clear lacquer is applied to keep the luster.The baffle surface of the enclosure uses Yamaha's unique bending and kneading round baffle. This is based on the same method as the molding of the side plate of a grand piano. Twelve carefully examined birch slice plates are attached to the metal mold one by one. They are carefully bent and bonded together with a special adhesive under pressure. Thus, the front baffle has a round section without any intervening joint member.As a result, resonance due to insufficient strength of the enclosure, which occurs with the conventional round baffle for cutting the side plate, and loss at the joint surface due to the use of round-shaped joint members are suppressed.The joint with the side plate has been changed to the general 45-degree plane joint, and the finger joint method has been introduced, which is advantageous for structural strength and adhesive surface strength, so that the side plate receives the pressure of the front baffle straightly.In addition, the finger-joint joints are reinforced from the back of the enclosure using solid beech to ensure perfect strength around the round section.American Walnut is used for the exterior decoration material, and it has an open pore finish unique to Yamaha that makes use of the texture of the wood grain fabric.In order to avoid coloring caused by soldering errors, etc., we have introduced plasma spot welding, which does not use dissimilar metals between parts.In this method, part terminals are locally heated and welded together, and the contact potential difference due to dissimilar metals such as solder is suppressed to 0.We also use large MP capacitors and OFC (oxygen-free copper) wire-wound voice coils with a silicon-steel core.OFC (oxygen-free copper) wires are also used for internal wiring, and a large gold-plated screw type is used for speaker terminals, which is suitable for extremely thick cables."

name: VS-E1
description: "This is a compact speaker system that uses a dome on the newly developed Omu.It is designed so that sound field reproduction by DSP-1 etc. can be enjoyed smartly.A 12 cm cone type woofer is used for the low range.It uses SFCC (Super Fine Ceramic Composite) cone with improved response characteristics by combining ceramic with cone paper. It combines with the edge of polymer material to realize smooth sound rise.A 3 cm omnidome type tweeter is used for the high range.In order to make the most of the sound field characteristics of DSP-1, which collects reflected sound in 360 degree direction, the diaphragm is made into an omnidome shape, which is formed into almost a hemisphere shape.Both low-pass and high-pass units are designed with a complete anti-magnetic design using a canceling magnet system to prevent adverse effects on monitors, etc.An OFC (oxygen-free copper) air-core coil is used for the network, and the internal wiring material is also OFC to suppress signal degradation.In consideration of sound quality and space saving, a thin cabinet made of high-density resin is adopted.As a sealed type with a sound absorbing material inside, smooth low-frequency reproduction without sudden phase inversion has been obtained. This prevents complex interference and cancellation effects with the low-frequency range of the main speaker, and more natural spatial synthesis of the reflected sound component and the stereo sound image produced by the main speaker is performed to form the sound field.It comes with a simple stand and hook to adapt to various mounting and installation conditions.With the flexible stand that can change the orientation 360 degrees, it can be placed vertically or horizontally, and the degree of inclination can be adjusted. In addition, there are 2 types of hooks for vertical hook and yoko gake hook, which can be used according to the installation condition on the wall surface.The floor tall stand (VSS-1800G/W) was sold separately. It can be easily installed by removing the VS-E1 sub RUNNET.The speaker cord can be wired inside the stand.Comes with a fall prevention chain."
